```typescript
﻿<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">Consulta de Facturas</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Documentos de facturacion</p>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="card filtros-card">
    <div class="filtros-row">
      <div class="campo campo-busqueda">
        <span class="p-input-icon-left">
          <input
            pInputText
            type="text"
            pSize="small"
            placeholder="Buscar por # factura o nombre del cliente..."
            [ngModel]="q()"
            (ngModelChange)="q.set($event)"
            (keyup.enter)="buscar()"
            class="busqueda-input"
          />
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="filtros-acciones">
        <i class="pi pi-search"></i>
        <p-button
          label="Limpiar"
          icon="pi pi-times"
          severity="secondary"
          text
          size="small"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="limpiar()"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card tabla-card">
    <p-table
      [value]="filtered()"
      [loading]="cargando()"
      showGridlines
      [tableStyle]="{ 'min-width': '15rem' }"
      [paginator]="true"
      [rows]="20"
      [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
      [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
      currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords} facturas"
      styleClass="facturas-table"
    >
      <ng-template #header>
        <tr>
          <th style="width: 5rem"># Factura</th>
          <th style="width: 6rem">Fecha</th>
          <th style="width: 6rem" class="th-hora">Hora</th>
          <th>Cliente</th>
          <th style="width: 6rem">Tipo</th>
          <th style="width: 7rem">Total</th>
          <th style="width: 5rem">Anulada</th>
          <th style="width: 5rem">Contab.</th>
          <th style="width: 10rem" class="acciones-header">Acciones</th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template #body let-f>
        <tr
          (click)="ver(f.facturaId)"
          [class.row-anulada]="f.sn_anulada === 'S'"
          class="fila-click"
        >
          <td>
            <span class="nro-factura">{{ f.nrofactura }}</span>
          </td>
          <td>{{ fechaCorta(f.fecharegistro) }}</td>
          <td class="hora-cell">{{ horaCorta(f.fecharegistro) }}</td>
          <td>
            <span class="cliente-nombre">{{ f.nombrecliente || 'Sin cliente' }}</span>
          </td>
          <td>
            <p-tag
              [value]="getTipoLabel(f.tipofactura)"
              [severity]="getTipoSeverity(f.tipofactura)"
              styleClass="tag-sm"
            />
          </td>
          <td class="text-right total-cell">{{ moneda(f.total) }}</td>
          <td>
            <p-tag
              [value]="f.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'Si' : 'No'"
              [severity]="f.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'danger' : 'success'"
              styleClass="tag-sm"
            />
          </td>
          <td>
            <p-tag
              [value]="f.sn_contabilizada === 'S' ? 'Si' : 'No'"
              [severity]="f.sn_contabilizada === 'S' ? 'info' : 'secondary'"
              styleClass="tag-sm"
            />
          </td>
          <td class="acciones-cell">
            <div class="acciones-row">
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-eye"
                severity="info"
                text
                rounded
                size="small"
                (onClick)="ver(f.facturaId); $event.stopPropagation()"
                pTooltip="Ver factura"
                tooltipPosition="top"
              />
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-print"
                severity="secondary"
                text
                rounded
                size="small"
                (onClick)="reimprimir(f, $event)"
                pTooltip="Reimprimir"
                tooltipPosition="top"
              />
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-envelope"
                severity="warn"
                text
                rounded
                size="small"
                (onClick)="abrirCorreo(f, $event)"
                pTooltip="Enviar por correo"
                tooltipPosition="top"
              />
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-whatsapp"
                severity="success"
                text
                rounded
                size="small"
                (onClick)="compartirWhatsapp(f, $event)"
                pTooltip="WhatsApp"
                tooltipPosition="top"
                styleClass="btn-whatsapp-sm"
              />
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template #emptymessage>
        <tr>
          <td colspan="9" class="empty-state">
            <div class="empty-content">
              <i class="pi pi-file"></i>
              <p>No hay facturas registradas</p>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  </div>

  <p-dialog
    header="Enviar factura por correo"
    [(visible)]="dialogCorreo"
    [modal]="true"
    [style]="{ width: '420px' }"
    [draggable]="false"
    [resizable]="false"
    [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }"
    [closable]="true"
    styleClass="correo-dialog"
  >
    <div class="correo-form">
      <label class="correo-label">Correo electronico del destinatario</label>
      <input
        pInputText
        type="email"
        pSize="small"
        [ngModel]="emailDestino()"
        (ngModelChange)="emailDestino.set($event)"
        placeholder="correo@ejemplo.com"
        class="correo-input"
      />
    </div>
    <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
      <div class="correo-footer">
        <p-button
          label="Cancelar"
          severity="secondary"
          text
          size="small"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="dialogCorreo.set(false)"
        />
        <p-button
          label="Enviar"
          icon="pi pi-send"
          size="small"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="enviarCorreo()"
          [loading]="enviando()"
        />
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  </p-dialog>
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\consulta-facturas\consulta-facturas.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { FacturaImpresionService } from '../../../core/services/factura-impresion.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-consulta-facturas',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule, TooltipModule, DialogModule],
  templateUrl: './consulta-facturas.html',
  styleUrl: './consulta-facturas.scss',
})
export class ConsultaFacturas implements OnInit {
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private impresion = inject(FacturaImpresionService);

  facturas = signal<any[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<any[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  q = signal('');

  dialogCorreo = signal(false);
  emailDestino = signal('');
  enviando = signal(false);
  facturaSeleccionada = signal<any>(null);

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.api.get<any>('/facturacion/facturas').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        const items = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res?.value ?? []);
        this.facturas.set(items);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las facturas' });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const texto = this.q().toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!texto) {
      this.filtered.set(this.facturas());
      return;
    }
    this.filtered.set(
      this.facturas().filter((f) => {
        const nro = String(f.nrofactura ?? '');
        const cliente = (f.nombrecliente ?? '').toLowerCase();
        return nro.includes(texto) || cliente.includes(texto);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() { this.filtrar(); }
  limpiar() { this.q.set(''); this.filtrar(); }

  ver(id: number) {
    this.router.navigate(['/facturacion/consultas', id]);
  }

  fechaCorta(fecha: string | Date): string {
    if (!fecha) return '-';
    const d = new Date(fecha);
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const yy = String(d.getFullYear()).slice(-2);
    return `${dd}/${mm}/${yy}`;
  }

  horaCorta(fecha: string | Date): string {
    if (!fecha) return '-';
    const d = new Date(fecha);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString('es-HN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }

  getTipoLabel(tipo: string): string {
    return tipo === 'C' ? 'Credito' : 'Contado';
  }

  getTipoSeverity(tipo: string): string {
    return tipo === 'C' ? 'warn' : 'success';
  }

  getEstado(f: any): string {
    if (f.sn_anulada === 'S') return 'Anulada';
    if (f.sn_pagada === 'S') return 'Pagada';
    return 'Pendiente';
  }

  getEstadoSeverity(f: any): string {
    if (f.sn_anulada === 'S') return 'danger';
    if (f.sn_pagada === 'S') return 'success';
    return 'warn';
  }

  // ==================== REIMPRIMIR ====================

  async reimprimir(f: any, $event?: Event) {
    $event?.stopPropagation();
    try {
      const data = await this.api.get<any>(`/facturacion/facturas/${f.facturaId}/ticket`).toPromise();
      if (!data) return;
      // El formato (TICKET/CARTA) lo resuelve el servicio desde timpresoras
      await this.impresion.imprimir(data);
    } catch {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo generar la impresión' });
    }
  }

  // ==================== CORREO ====================

  abrirCorreo(f: any, $event?: Event) {
    $event?.stopPropagation();
    this.facturaSeleccionada.set(f);
    this.emailDestino.set('');
    this.dialogCorreo.set(true);
  }

  enviarCorreo() {
    const email = this.emailDestino();
    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Correo invalido', detail: 'Ingrese un correo electronico valido' });
      return;
    }
    const f = this.facturaSeleccionada();
    if (!f) return;
    this.enviando.set(true);
    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
    this.api.post<any>(`facturacion/facturas/${f.facturaId}/enviar-correo?empresaId=${empresaId}`, { email }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        this.enviando.set(false);
        this.dialogCorreo.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Correo enviado', detail: res.message || 'Factura enviada a ' + email });
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.enviando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'Error al enviar correo' });
      },
    });
  }

  // ==================== WHATSAPP ====================

  async compartirWhatsapp(f: any, $event?: Event) {
    $event?.stopPropagation();
    try {
      const data = await this.api.get<any>(`/facturacion/facturas/${f.facturaId}/ticket`).toPromise();
      if (!data) return;

      const id = f.nrofactura || f.facturaId;
      const total = this.moneda(f.total);
      const nombre = f.nombrecliente || 'Cliente';
      const texto = encodeURIComponent(`Factura #${id} - ${nombre} - Total: ${total}`);

      // PDF en el formato parametrizado (TICKET 80mm o CARTA LETTER)
      const blob = await this.impresion.getBlob(data);
      const file = new File([blob], 'factura-' + id + '.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' });

      if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Factura #' + id });
      } else {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = 'factura-' + id + '.pdf';
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        window.open('https://wa.me/?text=' + texto, '_blank');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e?.name !== 'AbortError') {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo compartir la factura' });
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\cotizaciones\cotizaciones-form\cotizaciones-form.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ToolbarModule } from 'primeng/toolbar';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';
import { ApiService } from '../../../../core/services/api.service';
import { FacturacionService } from '../../../../core/services/facturacion.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { Producto } from '../../../../core/models/inventario.models';
import { ProductosHelperList } from '../../../helpers/productos';
import { FooterHelper } from '../../../helpers/footer';

interface FilaDet {
  fila: number;
  productoId: number | null;
  codbarra: string;
  descripcion: string;
  imagenUrl?: string | null;
  estado?: string;
  cantidad: number;
  precio: number;
  subTotal: number;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-cotizaciones-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule,
    TableModule,
    ToolbarModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
    DialogModule,
  ],
  providers: [DialogService],
  templateUrl: './cotizaciones-form.html',
  styleUrl: './cotizaciones-form.scss',
})
export class CotizacionesForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private service = inject(FacturacionService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  ref: DynamicDialogRef | undefined;

  form!: FormGroup;

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nueva Cotizacion');

  gestores = signal<any[]>([]);

  filas = signal<FilaDet[]>([]);
  totales = signal({ subTotal: 0, impuesto: 0, total: 0 });
  mae = signal<any>(null);

  qProducto = signal('');
  dialogProductos = signal(false);
  dialogCorreo = signal(false);
  empresaDet = signal<any[]>([]);
  empresaNombre = 'EMPRESA';
  emailDestino = signal('');
  productosArray: Producto[] = [];
  productosFiltrados = signal<Producto[]>([]);

  private existenciasMap = new Map<number, number>();
  private imagenesMap = new Map<number, string>();
  private tasaImpuesto = 0.15;
  private contadorFila = 0;
  private cotizacionId: number | null = null;

  constructor(public dialogService: DialogService) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.buildForm();
    this.cargarGestores();
    this.cargarProductos();
    this.cargarEmpresa();

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id && id !== 'nuevo') {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.cotizacionId = Number(id);
      this.titulo.set('Editar Cotizacion #' + id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.cargarCotizacion(Number(id));
    }
  }

  private buildForm() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      Nombrecliente: ['', Validators.required],
      direccion: ['', Validators.required],
      atendio: ['', Validators.required],
      gestorId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    });
  }

  private cargarGestores() {
    this.api.get<any>('/parametros/gestores').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const items = res?.value ?? (Array.isArray(res) ? res : []);
        this.gestores.set((items ?? []).map((g: any) => ({
          label: g.nombre || 'Gestor #' + g.g_gestorId,
          value: g.g_gestorId,
        })));
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarProductos() {
    this.api.get<any[]>('/inventario/existencias').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (items) => {
        const m = new Map<number, number>();
        for (const e of items ?? []) {
          const id = Number(e.productoId);
          m.set(id, (m.get(id) ?? 0) + Number(e.existencia ?? 0));
        }
        this.existenciasMap = m;

        this.api.get<any[]>('/inventario/productos').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (prods) => {
            this.productosArray = ((prods ?? []) as Producto[]).filter((p) => m.has(Number(p.produtoId)));
            this.filtrarProductos();
          },
        });
      },
    });

    this.api.get<any[]>('/inventario/productos-img').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (items) => {
        const m = new Map<number, string>();
        for (const i of items ?? []) {
          const id = Number(i.productoId);
          if (i.sn_activo === 'S' && i.img && !m.has(id)) {
            m.set(id, /^data:/i.test(i.img) ? i.img : 'data:image/png;base64,' + i.img);
          }
        }
        this.imagenesMap = m;
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarCotizacion(id: number) {
    this.api.get<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones/' + id).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (mae) => {
        this.mae.set(mae);
        this.form.patchValue({
          Nombrecliente: mae.Nombrecliente,
          direccion: mae.direccion,
          atendio: mae.atendio,
          gestorId: mae.gestorId,
        });
        this.cargarDetalles(id);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Cotizacion no encontrada' });
        this.volver();
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarDetalles(cotizacionId: number) {
    this.api.get<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones-det/mae/' + cotizacionId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const dets = res?.value ?? (Array.isArray(res) ? res : []);
        for (const d of dets) {
          const row: FilaDet = {
            fila: ++this.contadorFila,
            productoId: Number(d.productoId) || null,
            codbarra: d.codbarra ?? '',
            descripcion: d.codbarra ?? '',
            imagenUrl: this.imagenesMap.get(Number(d.productoId)) ?? null,
            estado: 'ALTA',
            cantidad: Number(d.cantidad) || 1,
            precio: Number(d.precio) || 0,
            subTotal: Number(d.subTotal) || 0,
          };
          this.filas.update((f) => [...f, row]);
        }
        this.recalcularTotales();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarEmpresa() {
    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
    if (!empresaId) return;
    this.api.get<any>('/companies/' + empresaId)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe((emp) => {
        this.empresaNombre = emp?.descripcion || 'EMPRESA';
      });
    this.api.get<any>('/companies/det', { empresaId })
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe((det) => {
        const items = det?.value ?? (Array.isArray(det) ? det : []);
        this.empresaDet.set(items);
      });
  }

  filtrarProductos() {
    const q = this.qProducto().toLowerCase().trim();
    this.productosFiltrados.set(
      q
        ? this.productosArray.filter(
            (p) =>
              (p.codbarra ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
              (p.descripcion ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
          )
        : this.productosArray,
    );
  }

  onBuscarProducto(event: Event) {
    const texto = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value ?? '';
    this.qProducto.set(texto);

    if (texto.length >= 13) {
      this.api.get<any>('/inventario/productos/buscar', { q: texto.trim() }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          const items = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res?.value ?? []);
          const producto = items.find((p: any) => (p.codbarra ?? '').trim().startsWith(texto.trim()));
          if (producto) {
            this.agregarProductoDirecto(producto);
            this.qProducto.set('');
          } else {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'No encontrado', detail: 'No se encontro producto con codigo ' + texto });
          }
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private agregarProductoDirecto(p: Producto) {
    const productoId = Number(p.produtoId) || null;
    const tieneRegistro = this.existenciasMap.has(productoId ?? -1);
    const existencia = Number(this.existenciasMap.get(productoId ?? -1) ?? 0);

    if (tieneRegistro && existencia <= 0) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Sin existencia', detail: p.descripcion + ' no tiene existencia disponible' });
      return;
    }

    const estado = !tieneRegistro ? 'SIN_STOCK' : existencia <= 0 ? 'AGOTADO' : 'ALTA';
    this.agregarFila(p, estado);
  }

  showHelperProductos() {
    this.ref = this.dialogService.open(ProductosHelperList, {
      header: 'Seleccionar un producto',
      width: '50vw',
      modal: true,
      contentStyle: { overflow: 'auto' },
      breakpoints: { '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' },
      templates: { footer: FooterHelper },
    });

    this.ref.onClose.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe((data: any) => {
      if (data) {
        const productoId = Number(data.produtoId) || null;
        const existencia = Number(this.existenciasMap.get(productoId ?? -1) ?? 0);
        const stockMin = Number(data.stockMinimo ?? 0);
        const estado = existencia <= 0 ? 'AGOTADO' : existencia <= stockMin ? 'BAJO' : 'ALTA';

        if (estado === 'AGOTADO') {
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Sin existencia', detail: data.descripcion + ' no tiene existencia disponible' });
          return;
        }

        this.agregarFila(data, estado);
      }
    });
  }

  private agregarFila(p: any, estado: string) {
    const productoId = Number(p.produtoId) || null;
    const row: FilaDet = {
      fila: ++this.contadorFila,
      productoId,
      codbarra: p.codbarra ?? '',
      descripcion: p.descripcion ?? '',
      imagenUrl: this.imagenesMap.get(productoId ?? -1) ?? null,
      estado,
      cantidad: 1,
      precio: Number(p.precioventa) || 0,
      subTotal: Number(p.precioventa) || 0,
    };
    this.filas.update((f) => [...f, row]);
    this.recalcularFila(row);
  }

  quitarFila(idx: number) {
    this.filas.update((f) => f.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    this.recalcularTotales();
  }

  recalcularFila(row: FilaDet) {
    const cantidad = row.cantidad ?? 0;
    const precio = row.precio ?? 0;
    row.subTotal = Math.round(cantidad * precio * 100) / 100;
    this.filas.update((f) => [...f]);
    this.recalcularTotales();
  }

  recalcularTotales() {
    let subTotal = 0;
    for (const r of this.filas()) {
      subTotal += r.subTotal ?? 0;
    }
    const impuesto = Math.round(subTotal * this.tasaImpuesto * 100) / 100;
    const total = Math.round((subTotal + impuesto) * 100) / 100;
    this.totales.set({ subTotal, impuesto, total });
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  getSeverity(estado: string): string {
    switch (estado) {
      case 'ALTA': return 'success';
      case 'BAJO': return 'warn';
      case 'AGOTADO': return 'danger';
      case 'SIN_STOCK': return 'info';
      default: return 'secondary';
    }
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['/facturacion/cotizaciones']);
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Validacion', detail: 'Complete los campos obligatorios' });
      return;
    }
    const filasArr = this.filas();
    if (filasArr.length === 0) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Validacion', detail: 'Agregue al menos un producto' });
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const maeBody = {
      Nombrecliente: raw.Nombrecliente,
      direccion: raw.direccion,
      atendio: raw.atendio,
      gestorId: raw.gestorId,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);

    if (this.esEdicion() && this.cotizacionId) {
      this.service.updateMae<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones', this.cotizacionId, maeBody).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
        next: () => this.guardarDetalles(this.cotizacionId!),
        error: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo actualizar la cotizacion' });
        },
      });
    } else {
      this.service.createMae<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones', maeBody).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          const id = res.poscotmaeId;
          this.guardarDetalles(id);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar la cotizacion' });
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private guardarDetalles(cotizacionId: number) {
    const filasArr = this.filas();
    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;

    if (this.esEdicion()) {
      this.volverConMensaje('Cotizacion #' + cotizacionId + ' actualizada');
      return;
    }

    const detOps = filasArr.map((r) =>
      this.service.createDet<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones-det', {
        poscotmaeId: cotizacionId,
        productoId: r.productoId,
        codbarra: r.codbarra || '',
        cantidad: r.cantidad ?? 0,
        precio: r.precio ?? 0,
        subTotal: r.subTotal,
        empresaId,
      }),
    );

    forkJoin(detOps).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Cotizacion #' + cotizacionId + ' creada' });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Advertencia', detail: 'Cotizacion #' + cotizacionId + ' creada, pero fallo el detalle' });
        this.volver();
      },
    });
  }

  private volverConMensaje(mensaje: string) {
    this.guardando.set(false);
    this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: mensaje });
    this.volver();
  }

  // ==================== PDF / Correo / WhatsApp ====================

  async imprimirPDF(): Promise<void> {
    const pdfMake: any = (await import('pdfmake/build/pdfmake')).default;
    const pdfFonts: any = (await import('pdfmake/build/vfs_fonts')).default;
    pdfMake.vfs = pdfFonts.pdfMake ? pdfFonts.pdfMake.vfs : pdfFonts;
    pdfMake.createPdf(this.buildPdfDefinition()).print();
  }

  async descargarPDF(): Promise<void> {
    const pdfMake: any = (await import('pdfmake/build/pdfmake')).default;
    const pdfFonts: any = (await import('pdfmake/build/vfs_fonts')).default;
    pdfMake.vfs = pdfFonts.pdfMake ? pdfFonts.pdfMake.vfs : pdfFonts;
    const id = this.mae()?.poscotmaeId || 'nueva';
    pdfMake.createPdf(this.buildPdfDefinition()).download('cotizacion-' + id + '.pdf');
  }

  async compartir(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const pdfMake: any = (await import('pdfmake/build/pdfmake')).default;
      const pdfFonts: any = (await import('pdfmake/build/vfs_fonts')).default;
      pdfMake.vfs = pdfFonts.pdfMake ? pdfFonts.pdfMake.vfs : pdfFonts;
      const id = this.mae()?.poscotmaeId || 'nueva';
      const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve) => {
        (pdfMake as any).createPdf(this.buildPdfDefinition()).getBlob(resolve);
      });
      const file = new File([blob], 'cotizacion-' + id + '.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' });
      if (navigator.share) {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Cotizacion #' + id });
      } else {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'No disponible', detail: 'Web Share API no soportada' });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e?.name !== 'AbortError') {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo compartir' });
      }
    }
  }

  abrirDialogCorreo(): void {
    this.emailDestino.set('');
    this.dialogCorreo.set(true);
  }

  enviarCorreo(): void {
    const emailVal = this.emailDestino();
    if (!emailVal || !emailVal.includes('@')) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Correo invalido', detail: 'Ingrese un correo electronico valido' });
      return;
    }
    const id = this.mae()?.poscotmaeId;
    if (!id) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Sin cotizacion', detail: 'Guarde la cotizacion antes de enviar por correo' });
      return;
    }
    this.guardando.set(true);
    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
    this.api.post<any>('facturacion/cotizaciones/' + id + '/enviar-correo?empresaId=' + empresaId, { email: emailVal }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.dialogCorreo.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Correo enviado', detail: res.message || 'Cotizacion enviada a ' + emailVal });
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'Error al enviar correo' });
      },
    });
  }

  private buildPdfDefinition(): any {
    const maeData = this.mae();
    const filasData = (this.filas() ?? []).filter((f: FilaDet) => f.productoId);
    const totalesData = this.totales() ?? { subTotal: 0, impuesto: 0, total: 0 };
    const now = new Date();

    const det = this.empresaDet();
    const rtn = det.find((d: any) => d.tipo === 'RTN')?.descripcion || '';
    const dirEmpresa = det.find((d: any) => d.tipo === 'DIRECCION')?.descripcion || '';
    const tel = det.find((d: any) => d.tipo === 'TELEFONO')?.descripcion || '';

    return {
      pageSize: 'LETTER',
      pageMargins: [40, 60, 40, 60],
      content: [
        { text: this.empresaNombre, style: 'header', alignment: 'center' },
        { text: rtn ? 'RTN: ' + rtn : '', alignment: 'center', fontSize: 9 },
        { text: dirEmpresa, alignment: 'center', fontSize: 9 },
        { text: tel ? 'Tel: ' + tel : '', alignment: 'center', fontSize: 9 },
        { text: '\n' },
        { text: 'COTIZACION', style: 'header', alignment: 'center' },
        { text: '#' + (maeData?.poscotmaeId || 'Nueva'), style: 'subheader', alignment: 'center' },
        { text: 'Fecha: ' + now.toLocaleDateString('es-HN'), alignment: 'right', margin: [0, 5] },
        { text: '\n' },
        {
          columns: [
            { text: [
              { text: 'Cliente: ', bold: true }, (maeData?.Nombrecliente || this.form.value.Nombrecliente || ''),
              '\n', { text: 'Direccion: ', bold: true }, (maeData?.direccion || this.form.value.direccion || ''),
              '\n', { text: 'Atendio: ', bold: true }, (maeData?.atendio || this.form.value.atendio || ''),
            ], width: '*' },
          ],
        },
        { text: '\n' },
        {
          table: {
            headerRows: 1,
            widths: ['*', 'auto', 'auto', 'auto'],
            body: [
              [
                { text: 'Producto', style: 'tableHeader' },
                { text: 'Precio', style: 'tableHeader', alignment: 'right' },
                { text: 'Cant.', style: 'tableHeader', alignment: 'right' },
                { text: 'Subtotal', style: 'tableHeader', alignment: 'right' },
              ],
              ...filasData.map((f: FilaDet) => [
                f.descripcion || f.codbarra,
                'L ' + Number(f.precio).toFixed(2),
                '' + Number(f.cantidad),
                'L ' + Number(f.subTotal).toFixed(2),
              ]),
            ],
          },
          layout: 'lightHorizontalLines',
        },
        { text: '\n' },
        {
          alignment: 'right',
          columns: [
            { width: '*', text: '' },
            { width: 200, text: [
              { text: 'Subtotal: ', bold: true }, 'L ' + Number(totalesData.subTotal).toFixed(2),
              '\n', { text: 'ISV 15%: ', bold: true }, 'L ' + Number(totalesData.impuesto).toFixed(2),
              '\n', { text: 'TOTAL: ', bold: true, fontSize: 14 }, { text: 'L ' + Number(totalesData.total).toFixed(2), bold: true, fontSize: 14, color: '#10b981' },
            ] },
          ],
        },
      ],
      styles: {
        header: { fontSize: 20, bold: true },
        subheader: { fontSize: 14, margin: [0, 5] },
        tableHeader: { bold: true, fontSize: 10, color: 'white', fillColor: '#10b981' },
      },
      defaultStyle: { fontSize: 10 },
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">Cotizaciones</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Cotizaciones de venta</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p-button label="Nueva" icon="pi pi-plus" size="small" [rounded]="true" (onClick)="nuevo()" />
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="card filtros-card">
    <div class="filtros-row">
      <div class="campo campo-busqueda">
        <span class="p-input-icon-left">
          <input pInputText type="text" pSize="small"
            placeholder="Buscar por # cotización, nombre del cliente o atendió..."
            [ngModel]="q()" (ngModelChange)="q.set($event)" (keyup.enter)="buscar()" class="busqueda-input" />
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="filtros-acciones">
        <i class="pi pi-search"></i>
        <p-button label="Limpiar" icon="pi pi-times" severity="secondary" text size="small" [rounded]="true" (onClick)="limpiar()" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card tabla-card">
    <p-table [value]="filtered()" [loading]="cargando()"
    showGridlines
    [tableStyle]="{ 'min-width': '40rem' }"
     [paginator]="true" [rows]="20"
      [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]" [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
      currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords} cotizaciones"
      styleClass="cotizaciones-table">
      <ng-template #header>
        <tr>
          <th style="width:6rem"># Cotización</th>
          <th style="width:6rem">Fecha</th>
          <th style="width:5rem" class="th-hora">Hora</th>
          <th>Cliente</th>
          <th style="width:8rem">Atendió</th>
          <th style="width:6rem">Estado</th>
          <th style="width:10rem" class="acciones-header">Acciones</th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template #body let-item>
        <tr (click)="editar(item.poscotmaeId)" class="fila-click" [class.row-anulada]="item.sn_estadocarrito === 'X'">
          <td>
            <span class="nro-factura">{{ item.poscotmaeId }}</span>
          </td>
          <td>{{ fechaCorta(item.fecharegistro) }}</td>
          <td class="hora-cell">{{ horaCorta(item.fecharegistro) }}</td>
          <td>
            <span class="cliente-nombre">{{ item.Nombrecliente || 'Sin cliente' }}</span>
          </td>
          <td>{{ item.atendio || '-' }}</td>
          <td>
            <p-tag [value]="estadoLabel(item)" [severity]="estadoSeverity(item)" styleClass="tag-sm" />
          </td>
          <td class="acciones-cell">
            <div class="acciones-row">
              <p-button icon="pi pi-pencil" severity="info" text rounded size="small"
                (onClick)="editar(item.poscotmaeId); $event.stopPropagation()" pTooltip="Editar" tooltipPosition="top" />
              <p-button icon="pi pi-envelope" severity="warn" text rounded size="small"
                (onClick)="abrirCorreo(item, $event)" pTooltip="Enviar por correo" tooltipPosition="top"
                [disabled]="!esActiva(item)" />
              <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" text rounded size="small"
                (onClick)="eliminar(item, $event)" pTooltip="Eliminar" tooltipPosition="top"
                [disabled]="!esActiva(item)" />
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template #emptymessage>
        <tr>
          <td colspan="7" class="empty-state">
            <div class="empty-content">
              <i class="pi pi-file"></i>
              <p>No hay cotizaciones registradas</p>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  </div>

  <p-confirmDialog [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [style]="{ width: '420px' }" />

  <p-dialog header="Enviar cotización por correo" [(visible)]="dialogCorreo" [modal]="true" [style]="{ width: '420px' }" [draggable]="false" [resizable]="false"
    [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [closable]="true" styleClass="correo-dialog">
    <div class="correo-form">
      <label class="correo-label">Correo electrónico del destinatario</label>
      <input pInputText type="email" pSize="small" [ngModel]="emailDestino()" (ngModelChange)="emailDestino.set($event)"
        placeholder="correo@ejemplo.com" class="correo-input" />
    </div>
    <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
      <div class="correo-footer">
        <p-button label="Cancelar" severity="secondary" text size="small" [rounded]="true" (onClick)="dialogCorreo.set(false)" />
        <p-button label="Enviar" icon="pi pi-send" size="small" [rounded]="true" (onClick)="enviarCorreo()" [loading]="enviando()" />
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  </p-dialog>
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\cotizaciones\cotizaciones-list\cotizaciones-list.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { ConfirmationService, MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ApiService } from '../../../../core/services/api.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-cotizaciones-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule, TooltipModule, ConfirmDialogModule, DialogModule],
  providers: [ConfirmationService],
  templateUrl: './cotizaciones-list.html',
  styleUrl: './cotizaciones-list.scss',
})
export class CotizacionesList implements OnInit {
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);

  data = signal<any[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<any[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  q = signal('');

  dialogCorreo = signal(false);
  emailDestino = signal('');
  enviando = signal(false);
  seleccionada = signal<any>(null);

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.api.get<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const items = res?.value ?? (Array.isArray(res) ? res : []);
        this.data.set(items);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las cotizaciones' });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const texto = this.q().toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!texto) {
      this.filtered.set(this.data());
      return;
    }
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        const nro = String(i.poscotmaeId ?? '');
        const cliente = (i.Nombrecliente ?? '').toLowerCase();
        const atendio = (i.atendio ?? '').toLowerCase();
        return nro.includes(texto) || cliente.includes(texto) || atendio.includes(texto);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() { this.filtrar(); }
  limpiar() { this.q.set(''); this.filtrar(); }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['/facturacion/cotizaciones/editar', 'nuevo']);
  }

  editar(id: number) {
    this.router.navigate(['/facturacion/cotizaciones/editar', id]);
  }

  eliminar(item: any, event: Event) {
    this.confirmation.confirm({
      target: event.target as EventTarget,
      message: `¿Eliminar cotización #${item.poscotmaeId}?`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonProps: { severity: 'danger', variant: 'text', size: 'small', rounded: true },
      rejectButtonProps: { severity: 'secondary', variant: 'text', size: 'small', rounded: true },
      accept: () => {
        this.api.delete<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones', item.poscotmaeId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Eliminada', detail: 'Cotización eliminada' });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo eliminar la cotización' });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  fechaCorta(fecha: string | Date): string {
    if (!fecha) return '-';
    const d = new Date(fecha);
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const yy = String(d.getFullYear()).slice(-2);
    return `${dd}/${mm}/${yy}`;
  }

  horaCorta(fecha: string | Date): string {
    if (!fecha) return '-';
    const d = new Date(fecha);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString('es-HN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }

  estadoLabel(item: any): string {
    switch (item.sn_estadocarrito) {
      case 'A': return 'Activa';
      case 'F': return 'Facturada';
      case 'X': return 'Anulada';
      default: return item.sn_estadocarrito ?? 'N/A';
    }
  }

  estadoSeverity(item: any): string {
    switch (item.sn_estadocarrito) {
      case 'A': return 'success';
      case 'F': return 'info';
      case 'X': return 'danger';
      default: return 'secondary';
    }
  }

  esActiva(item: any): boolean {
    return item.sn_estadocarrito === 'A';
  }

  // ==================== CORREO ====================

  abrirCorreo(item: any, event?: Event) {
    event?.stopPropagation();
    this.seleccionada.set(item);
    this.emailDestino.set('');
    this.dialogCorreo.set(true);
  }

  enviarCorreo() {
    const email = this.emailDestino();
    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Correo inválido', detail: 'Ingrese un correo electrónico válido' });
      return;
    }
    const item = this.seleccionada();
    if (!item) return;
    this.enviando.set(true);
    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
    this.api.post<any>(`facturacion/cotizaciones/${item.poscotmaeId}/enviar-correo?empresaId=${empresaId}`, { email }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        this.enviando.set(false);
        this.dialogCorreo.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Correo enviado', detail: res.message || 'Cotización enviada a ' + email });
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.enviando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'Error al enviar correo' });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">{{ titulo() }}</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">{{ config?.subtitulo }}</p>
    </div>
    <p-button label="Volver" icon="pi pi-arrow-left" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded
      (onClick)="volver()" />
  </header>

  @if (cargando()) {
  <div class="card">Cargando datos...</div>
  } @else {
  <form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="guardar()">
    <div class="card form-grid">
      @for (c of camposMae; track c.key) {
      @if (!c.oculto) {
      <div class="campo">
        <label [for]="c.key">{{ c.label }} @if (c.requerido) {<span class="req">*</span>}</label>

        @if (c.tipo === 'texto') {
        @if (c.soloLectura) {
        <input pInputText pSize="small" [id]="c.key" [formControlName]="c.key" readonly class="bg-gray-100" />
        } @else {
        <input pInputText [id]="c.key" [formControlName]="c.key" maxlength="120" [placeholder]="c.label"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid(c.key) }" />
        }
        } @else if (c.tipo === 'numero') {
        <p-inputnumber size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [showButtons]="true"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid(c.key) }" />
        } @else if (c.tipo === 'select') {
        <div class="flex gap-2">
          @if (c.key === 'documentoId') {
          <p-select size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [options]="opcionesDocumento()" optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value" placeholder="Tipo documento..." styleClass="w-full" filter filterBy="label"
            [appendTo]="'body'" (ngModelChange)="onDocumentoIdChange()" />
          } @else if (c.key === 'nrodocumento') {
          <p-select size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [options]="opcionesNroDocumento()" optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value" placeholder="Nro. documento..." styleClass="w-full" filter filterBy="label"
            [appendTo]="'body'" />
          } @else {
          <p-select size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [options]="opciones(c)" optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value" placeholder="Seleccionar..." styleClass="w-full" [filter]="c.filtro ?? false"
            filterBy="label" [appendTo]="'body'" />
          }
          @if (c.selector) {
          <p-button type="button" icon="pi pi-search" severity="secondary" (onClick)="abrirSelector(c.selector)" />
          }
        </div>
        } @else if (c.tipo === 'fecha') {
        <p-datepicker [formControlName]="c.key" dateFormat="dd/mm/yy" styleClass="w-full" />
        }

        @if (invalid(c.key)) {
        <small class="err">{{ c.label }} es obligatorio</small>
        }
      </div>
      }
      }
    </div>

    @if (camposDet.length > 0) {
    <div class="card">
      <div class="detalles-head">
        <h2 class="detalles-title">Detalles</h2>
        <p-button type="button" label="Agregar fila" icon="pi pi-plus" variant="text" severity="success" size="small"
          [rounded]="true" (onClick)="nuevaFila()" />
      </div>

      <p-table [value]="dets()" [scrollable]="true" scrollHeight="400px" styleClass="det-table" [paginator]="true"
        [rows]="10" [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]" [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
        currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}" size="small">
        <ng-template #header>
          <tr>
            @for (c of camposDet; track c.key) {
            @if (!c.oculto) {
            <th>{{ c.label }}</th>
            }
            }
            <th style="width: 80px"></th>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template #body let-row let-idx="rowIndex">
          <tr>
            @for (c of camposDet; track c.key) {
            @if (!c.oculto) {
            <td>
              @if (c.tipo === 'numero') {
              <p-inputnumber size="small" [(ngModel)]="row[c.key]" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }" />
              } @else if (c.tipo === 'fecha') {
              <p-datepicker [(ngModel)]="row[c.key]" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }" dateFormat="dd/mm/yy"
                styleClass="w-full" />
              } @else if (c.tipo === 'select') {
              @if (c.key === 'formapagoId') {
              <p-select size="small" [ngModel]="row[c.key]"
                (ngModelChange)="row[c.key] = $event; onFormaPagoChange(row)" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
                [options]="opciones(c)" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value" placeholder="Seleccionar..."
                styleClass="w-full" [filter]="c.filtro ?? false" filterBy="label" appendTo="body" />
              } @else {
              <p-select size="small" [ngModel]="row[c.key]" (ngModelChange)="row[c.key] = $event"
                [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }" [options]="opciones(c)" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value"
                placeholder="Seleccionar..." styleClass="w-full" [filter]="c.filtro ?? false" filterBy="label"
                appendTo="body" [disabled]="isCampoDesactivado(row, c.key)" />
              }
              } @else {
              <input pInputText pSize="small" [(ngModel)]="row[c.key]" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
                [disabled]="isCampoDesactivado(row, c.key)"
                [placeholder]="isCampoDesactivado(row, c.key) ? '' : c.label" />
              }
            </td>
            }
            }
            <td>
              <p-button type="button" icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" variant="text" [rounded]="true" size="small"
                [disabled]="!esNuevaFila(row)" (onClick)="quitarFila(idx)" />
            </td>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template #emptymessage>
          <tr>
            <td colspan="100" class="text-center p-3">Sin detalles. Agregue filas.</td>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
      </p-table>
    </div>
    }

    <div class="acciones-form">
      <p-button type="button" label="Cancelar" icon="pi pi-times" variant="text" severity="secondary" size="small"
        [rounded]="true" (onClick)="volver()" />
      <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" variant="text" severity="success" size="small"
        [rounded]="true" [loading]="guardando()" />
    </div>
  </form>
  }
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\maestro-detalle\maestro-detalle-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { DatePickerModule } from 'primeng/datepicker';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { FacturacionService } from '../../../core/services/facturacion.service';
import { MAESTRO_DETALLE, MaestroDetalleConfig, CampoMae, CampoDetalle } from '../../../core/models/facturacion.models';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { EntitySelectorHelper, EntitySelectorConfig } from '../../helpers/entity-selector';
import { FooterHelper } from '../../helpers/footer';
import { CxcService } from '../../../core/services/cxc.service';
import { NavegacionService } from '../../../core/services/navegacion.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-maestro-detalle-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule,
    DatePickerModule,
    TableModule,
  ],
  providers: [DialogService],
  templateUrl: './maestro-detalle-form.html',
  styleUrl: './maestro-detalle-form.scss',
})
export class MaestroDetalleForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(FacturacionService);
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private dialogService = inject(DialogService);
  private cxcService = inject(CxcService);
  private navegacion = inject(NavegacionService);
  ref: DynamicDialogRef | undefined;
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  config!: MaestroDetalleConfig;
  camposMae: CampoMae[] = [];
  camposDet: CampoDetalle[] = [];

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('');

  opcionesMap = signal<Record<string, { label: string; value: any }[]>>({});

  dets = signal<any[]>([]);
  detGuardados = new Set<number>();
  documentosPendientes = signal<any[]>([]);

  private itemId = 0;
  private contadorFila = 0;
  private factorCambioDefault = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    const nombre = this.route.snapshot.data['nombre'] ?? '';
    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id') ?? '';

    this.config = MAESTRO_DETALLE[nombre];
    if (!this.config) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: `Módulo desconocido: ${nombre}` });
      return;
    }
    this.camposMae = this.config.camposMae;
    this.camposDet = this.config.camposDet;
    this.titulo.set(this.config.titulo);
    this.buildForm();
    this.cargarOpciones();
    this.vigilarCliente();
    this.cargarFactorCambio();

    if (id && id !== 'nuevo') {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.itemId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getMaeOne<any>(this.config.rutaMae, this.itemId).subscribe({
        next: (mae) => {
          const patch: Record<string, any> = {};
          for (const c of this.camposMae) {
            const v = mae?.[c.key];
            patch[c.key] = c.tipo === 'fecha' && v ? new Date(v) : v;
          }
          this.form.patchValue(patch);
          this.cargarDets();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Registro no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private buildForm() {
    const group: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const c of this.camposMae) {
      const hasDefault = c.defaultValue !== undefined && c.defaultValue !== null;
      const initial = hasDefault ? c.defaultValue : (c.tipo === 'numero' ? 0 : null);
      group[c.key] = [initial, c.requerido ? Validators.required : []];
    }
    this.form = this.fb.group(group);
  }

  private cargarOpciones() {
    const all = [...this.camposMae, ...this.camposDet] as (CampoMae | CampoDetalle)[];
    for (const c of all) {
      if (c.cargaOpciones) {
        this.api.get<any>(c.cargaOpciones.url).subscribe({
          next: (res) => {
            let items: any[] = [];
            if (Array.isArray(res)) {
              items = res;
            } else if (res && typeof res === 'object') {
              const candidate = res.data ?? res.results ?? Object.values(res).find(Array.isArray) ?? [];
              items = Array.isArray(candidate) ? candidate : [];
            }
            let filtered = items;
            const filtro = (c as CampoMae).filtroAbreviaturas;
            if (filtro?.length) {
              filtered = filtered.filter((i: any) => filtro.includes(i.abreviatura));
            }
            const opts = filtered.map((i: any) => ({
              label: String(i[c.cargaOpciones!.labelCampo] ?? i[c.cargaOpciones!.valueCampo] ?? ''),
              value: i[c.cargaOpciones!.valueCampo],
            }));
            this.opcionesMap.update((m) => ({ ...m, [c.key]: opts }));
          },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  opciones(c: CampoMae | CampoDetalle): { label: string; value: any }[] {
    if (c.cargaOpciones) return this.opcionesMap()[c.key] ?? [];
    return (c as any).opciones ?? [];
  }

  esEfectivo(row: any): boolean {
    const opts = this.opcionesMap()['formapagoId'] ?? [];
    const selected = opts.find((o: any) => o.value === row['formapagoId']);
    return selected ? /efectivo/i.test(selected.label) : false;
  }

  onFormaPagoChange(row: any) {
    if (this.esEfectivo(row)) {
      row['tarjetacreditoId'] = null;
      row['nrotarjeta'] = '';
      row['nroautorizacion'] = '';
    }
  }

  isCampoDesactivado(row: any, key: string): boolean {
    const camposTarjeta = ['tarjetacreditoId', 'nrotarjeta', 'nroautorizacion'];
    return camposTarjeta.includes(key) && this.esEfectivo(row);
  }

  abrirSelector(selectorName: string) {
    (this as any)[selectorName]?.();
  }

  private vigilarCliente() {
    this.form.get('clienteId')?.valueChanges.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe((clienteId) => {
      if (!clienteId) {
        this.form.patchValue({ nrocliente: '', nombrecliente: '' });
        this.documentosPendientes.set([]);
        this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
        return;
      }
      this.api.get<any>(`/cxc/clientes/${clienteId}`).subscribe({
        next: (cliente) => this.form.patchValue({
          nrocliente: cliente?.nrocliente ?? '',
          nombrecliente: `${cliente?.nombres ?? ''} ${cliente?.apellidos ?? ''}`.trim(),
        }),
        error: () => this.form.patchValue({ nrocliente: '', nombrecliente: '' }),
      });
      this.cxcService.getDocumentosPendientesCliente(clienteId).subscribe({
        next: (docs) => {
          this.documentosPendientes.set(docs);
          this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.documentosPendientes.set([]);
          this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
        },
      });
    });
  }

  private filtrarOpcionesDocumento() {
    const docs = this.documentosPendientes();
    const tiposUnicos = [...new Set(docs.map(d => d.documentoId))];
    const allOpts = this.opcionesMap()['documentoId'] ?? [];
    const filtradas = allOpts.filter(o => tiposUnicos.includes(o.value));
    this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__docFiltradas']: filtradas }));
    this.form.get('documentoId')?.setValue(null);
    this.form.get('nrodocumento')?.setValue(null);
    this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__nroDocFiltradas']: [] }));
  }

  opcionesDocumento(): { label: string; value: any }[] {
    return this.opcionesMap()['__docFiltradas'] ?? this.opcionesMap()['documentoId'] ?? [];
  }

  opcionesNroDocumento(): { label: string; value: any }[] {
    const docId = this.form.get('documentoId')?.value;
    if (!docId) return [];
    const docs = this.documentosPendientes().filter(d => d.documentoId === docId);
    return docs.map(d => ({
      label: `${d.nroreferencia} (Saldo: ${d.saldo.toFixed(2)})`,
      value: d.nroreferencia,
    }));
  }

  onDocumentoIdChange() {
    const docId = this.form.get('documentoId')?.value;
    this.form.get('nrodocumento')?.setValue(null);
    if (docId) {
      const docs = this.documentosPendientes().filter(d => d.documentoId === docId);
      const opts = docs.map(d => ({
        label: `${d.nroreferencia} (Saldo: ${d.saldo.toFixed(2)})`,
        value: d.nroreferencia,
      }));
      this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__nroDocFiltradas']: opts }));
    } else {
      this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__nroDocFiltradas']: [] }));
    }
  }

  abrirClientes() {
    const config: EntitySelectorConfig = {
      titulo: 'Seleccionar cliente con saldo',
      columns: [
        { key: 'nrocliente', label: 'Nro.' },
        { key: 'cliente', label: 'Nombre' },
        { key: 'dni', label: 'DNI' },
        { key: 'rtn', label: 'RTN' },
      ],
      loadData: () => {
        return new Promise<any[]>((resolve) => {
          this.api.get<any>('/cxc/clientes-con-saldo').subscribe({
            next: (res) => {
              const items = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res?.data ?? []);
              resolve(items);
            },
            error: () => resolve([]),
          });
        });
      },
    };

    this.ref = this.dialogService.open(EntitySelectorHelper, {
      header: config.titulo,
      width: '60vw',
      modal: true,
      contentStyle: { overflow: 'auto' },
      data: { config },
      templates: { footer: FooterHelper },
    });

    this.ref.onClose.subscribe((cliente: any) => {
      if (cliente) {
        this.form.patchValue({
          clienteId: cliente.clienteId,
          nrocliente: cliente.nrocliente ?? '',
          nombrecliente: `${cliente.nombres ?? ''} ${cliente.apellidos ?? ''}`.trim(),
        });
      }
    });
  }

  private cargarFactorCambio() {
    this.api.get<any[]>('/contabilidad/factordecambio').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (items) => {
        const dolares = (items ?? [])
          .filter((f) => f.tipomoneda === 'D')
          .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.fecharegistro).getTime() - new Date(a.fecharegistro).getTime());
        if (dolares.length > 0) {
          this.factorCambioDefault = Number(dolares[0].preciocompra) || 0;
        }
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarDets() {
    const rutaDetById = this.config.rutaDetById
      ? `${this.config.rutaDetById}/${this.itemId}`
      : `${this.config.rutaDet}/factura/${this.itemId}`;
    this.service.getDet<any>(rutaDetById).subscribe({
      next: (mios) => {
        this.dets.set((mios ?? []).map((d) => ({ ...d })));
        for (const d of (mios ?? [])) this.detGuardados.add(d[this.config.idKeyDet]);
        this.contadorFila = (mios ?? []).length;
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.service.getDet<any>(this.config.rutaDet).subscribe({
          next: (todos) => {
            const mios = (todos ?? []).filter((d) => d[this.config.fkDet] === this.itemId);
            this.dets.set(mios.map((d) => ({ ...d })));
            for (const d of mios) this.detGuardados.add(d[this.config.idKeyDet]);
            this.contadorFila = mios.length;
            this.cargando.set(false);
          },
          error: () => {
            this.cargando.set(false);
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los detalles' });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  nuevaFila() {
    this.contadorFila += 1;
    const fila: any = { __local: true };
    for (const c of this.camposDet) {
      if (c.key === 'nrofila') fila[c.key] = this.contadorFila;
      else if (c.key === 'factordecambio') fila[c.key] = this.factorCambioDefault;
      else fila[c.key] = c.tipo === 'numero' ? 0 : c.tipo === 'fecha' ? new Date() : '';
    }
    this.dets.update((d) => [...d, fila]);
  }

  quitarFila(idx: number) {
    const fila = this.dets()[idx];
    if (fila[this.config.idKeyDet] && this.detGuardados.has(fila[this.config.idKeyDet])) return;
    this.dets.update((d) => d.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.navegacion.volver([this.config.rutaMae]);
  }

  esNuevaFila(fila: any): boolean {
    return !fila[this.config.idKeyDet] || !this.detGuardados.has(fila[this.config.idKeyDet]);
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const maeBody = {
      ...this.form.getRawValue(),
      ...(this.esEdicion() ? {} : { empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId }),
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const maeOp = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.updateMae<any>(this.config.rutaMae, this.itemId, maeBody as any)
      : this.service.createMae<any>(this.config.rutaMae, maeBody as any);

    maeOp.subscribe({
      next: (mae) => {
        const maeId = this.esEdicion() ? this.itemId : mae[this.config.idKeyMae];
        this.guardarDets(maeId);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar el documento' });
      },
    });
  }

  private guardarDets(maeId: number) {
    const pendientes = this.dets().length;
    if (pendientes === 0) {
      this.finalizar();
      return;
    }

    let completados = 0;
    const ok = () => {
      completados += 1;
      if (completados === pendientes) this.finalizar();
    };
    const fail = () => {
      this.guardando.set(false);
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar uno de los detalles' });
    };

    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
    for (const fila of this.dets()) {
      const detId = fila[this.config.idKeyDet];
      const body = { ...fila, [this.config.fkDet]: maeId, empresaId };
      delete body.__local;
      if (detId && this.detGuardados.has(detId)) {
        this.service.updateDet<any>(this.config.rutaDet, detId, body as any).subscribe({ next: ok, error: fail });
      } else {
        this.service.createDet<any>(this.config.rutaDet, body as any).subscribe({ next: ok, error: fail });
      }
    }
  }

  private finalizar() {
    this.guardando.set(false);
    this.msgs.add({
      severity: 'success',
      summary: 'Guardado',
      detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Documento actualizado' : 'Documento creado correctamente',
    });
    this.form.reset();
    for (const c of this.camposMae) {
      const hasDefault = c.defaultValue !== undefined && c.defaultValue !== null;
      const initial = hasDefault ? c.defaultValue : (c.tipo === 'numero' ? 0 : null);
      this.form.get(c.key)?.setValue(initial);
    }
    this.dets.set([]);
    this.detGuardados.clear();
    this.contadorFila = 0;
    this.documentosPendientes.set([]);
    this.esEdicion.set(false);
    this.itemId = 0;
    this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\maestro-detalle\maestro-detalle.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { FacturacionService } from '../../../core/services/facturacion.service';
import { MAESTRO_DETALLE, MaestroDetalleConfig } from '../../../core/models/facturacion.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-maestro-detalle',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, DataViewModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule],
  templateUrl: './maestro-detalle.html',
  styleUrl: './maestro-detalle.scss',
})
export class MaestroDetalle implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(FacturacionService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  config!: MaestroDetalleConfig;

  data = signal<any[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<any[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  layout: 'list' | 'grid' = 'list';

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    const nombre = this.route.snapshot.data['nombre'] ?? '';
    this.config = MAESTRO_DETALLE[nombre];
    if (!this.config) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: `Módulo desconocido: ${nombre}` });
      return;
    }
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getMae<any>(this.config.rutaMae).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: `No se pudieron cargar ${this.config.titulo}` });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return JSON.stringify(i).toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    if (this.config.soloLectura) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', 'nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id: number) {
    if (this.config.soloLectura) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }
}
```
