## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\tienda\tienda-virtual.ts

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, inject, signal, computed, DestroyRef, NgZone } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputMaskModule } from 'primeng/inputmask';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { MessageModule } from 'primeng/message';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { BadgeModule } from 'primeng/badge';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { TiendaService } from './tienda.service';
import { ProductoTienda, CarritoItem, CheckoutPago } from '../../../core/models/tienda.models';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tienda-virtual',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule, FormsModule, DataViewModule, ButtonModule, DialogModule,
    InputNumberModule, InputTextModule, InputMaskModule, SelectModule, TagModule, ToastModule,
    BadgeModule, TooltipModule, MessageModule,
  ],
  providers: [],
  templateUrl: './tienda-virtual.html',
  styleUrl: './tienda-virtual.scss',
})
export class TiendaVirtual implements OnInit {
  private tiendaService = inject(TiendaService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private messageService = inject(MessageService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private api = inject(ApiService);

  productos = signal<ProductoTienda[]>([]);
  carritoItems = signal<CarritoItem[]>([]);
  carritoId = signal<number | null>(null);
  busqueda = signal<string>('');
  layout = signal<'grid' | 'list'>('grid');
  cargando = signal(false);
  cargandoCarrito = signal(false);

  dialogCheckout = signal(false);
  procesando = signal(false);
  tarjetasCredito = signal<{ label: string; value: number }[]>([]);
  tarjetaError = signal<string | null>(null);
  carritoOpen = signal(false);

  /** Mapa productoId → precio con descuento de promo/oferta */
  private mapaOfertas = new Map<number, number>();
  /** Mapa productoId → porcentaje de descuento */
  private mapaDescuento = new Map<number, number>();

  // Image cache removed — browser handles caching natively

  categorias = computed(() => {
    const cats = new Set(this.productos().map(p => p.categoria).filter(Boolean));
    return [{ label: 'Todos', value: null }, ...Array.from(cats).map(c => ({ label: c!, value: c! }))];
  });
  categoriaFiltro = signal<string | null>(null);
  ordenarPor = signal<string>('default');
  soloOfertas = signal(false);

  readonly opcionesOrden = [
    { label: 'Destacados', value: 'default' },
    { label: 'Menor precio', value: 'precio-asc' },
    { label: 'Mayor precio', value: 'precio-desc' },
    { label: 'Nombre A-Z', value: 'nombre-asc' },
    { label: 'Nombre Z-A', value: 'nombre-desc' },
  ];

  productosFiltrados = computed(() => {
    let lista = this.productos();
    const cat = this.categoriaFiltro();
    const busq = this.busqueda().toLowerCase();
    const orden = this.ordenarPor();
    const soloOfertas = this.soloOfertas();

    if (soloOfertas) lista = lista.filter(p => this.esOferta(p));
    if (cat) lista = lista.filter(p => p.categoria === cat);
    if (busq) lista = lista.filter(p =>
      p.descripcion?.toLowerCase().includes(busq) ||
      p.codbarra?.toLowerCase().includes(busq)
    );

    const copia = [...lista];
    switch (orden) {
      case 'precio-asc': copia.sort((a, b) => Number(a.precioventa) - Number(b.precioventa)); break;
      case 'precio-desc': copia.sort((a, b) => Number(b.precioventa) - Number(a.precioventa)); break;
      case 'nombre-asc': copia.sort((a, b) => (a.descripcion || '').localeCompare(b.descripcion || '')); break;
      case 'nombre-desc': copia.sort((a, b) => (b.descripcion || '').localeCompare(a.descripcion || '')); break;
    }
    return copia;
  });

  totalItems = computed(() => this.carritoItems().reduce((sum, i) => sum + Number(i.cantidad), 0));
  totalCarrito = computed(() => this.carritoItems().reduce((sum, i) => sum + Number(i.subTotal), 0));

  checkout: CheckoutPago & { nrotarjeta?: string; tarjetacreditoId?: number; fechaexpiracion?: string; cvv?: string } = {
    poscotmaeId: 0,
    nombrecliente: '',
    direccion: '',
    formapagoId: 2,
    efectivo_recibido: 0,
    nrotarjeta: '',
    tarjetacreditoId: undefined,
    fechaexpiracion: '',
    cvv: '',
  };

  ngOnInit() {
    this.cargarProductos();
    this.cargarTarjetasCredito();
    this.cargarOfertas();
  }

  cargarProductos() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.tiendaService.getProductos(true)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          this.productos.set(data);
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.messageService.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los productos' });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
      });
  }

  cargarTarjetasCredito() {
    this.api.get<{ tarjetacreditoId: number; descripcion: string }[]>('/parametros/tarjetas-credito')
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          this.tarjetasCredito.set(data.map(t => ({ label: t.descripcion, value: t.tarjetacreditoId })));
        },
        error: () => {},
      });
  }

  /** Carga productos en oferta/promoción desde un solo endpoint */
  cargarOfertas() {
    this.api.get<any>('/facturacion/combos-ofertas')
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          const ofertas = res?.value ?? res ?? [];
          for (const o of (Array.isArray(ofertas) ? ofertas : [])) {
            const pid = Number(o.productoId);
            this.mapaOfertas.set(pid, Number(o.precioConDescuento));
            this.mapaDescuento.set(pid, Number(o.porcentaje));
          }
        },
        error: () => {},
      });
  }

  /** Retorna el precio con descuento si el producto está en oferta, null si no */
  getPrecioOferta(producto: ProductoTienda): number | null {
    return this.mapaOfertas.get(Number(producto.produtoId)) ?? null;
  }

  /** Retorna el porcentaje de descuento si el producto está en oferta, 0 si no */
  getPorcentajeDescuento(producto: ProductoTienda): number {
    return this.mapaDescuento.get(Number(producto.produtoId)) ?? 0;
  }

  /** Verifica si el producto está en una oferta/promoción */
  esOferta(producto: ProductoTienda): boolean {
    return this.mapaOfertas.has(Number(producto.produtoId));
  }

  async agregarAlCarrito(producto: ProductoTienda) {
    if (producto.existencia <= 0) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Sin stock', detail: 'Producto sin existencia' });
      return;
    }

    if (!this.carritoId()) {
      await this.crearCarrito();
    }

    const existing = this.carritoItems().find(i => i.productoId === String(producto.produtoId));
    const nuevaCant = existing ? existing.cantidad + 1 : 1;
    if (nuevaCant > producto.existencia) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Stock insuficiente', detail: `Solo quedan ${producto.existencia} unidades` });
      return;
    }

    this.cargandoCarrito.set(true);
    const payload = {
      poscotmaeId: this.carritoId()!,
      productoId: String(producto.produtoId),
      codbarra: producto.codbarra || '',
      cantidad: nuevaCant,
      precio: Number(producto.precioventa),
      subTotal: Number(producto.precioventa) * nuevaCant,
    };

    if (existing) {
      this.tiendaService.eliminarItem(existing.poscotdetId)
        .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
        .subscribe(() => {
          this.tiendaService.agregarItem(payload)
            .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
            .subscribe({
              next: () => this.recargarItems(),
              error: () => this.cargandoCarrito.set(false),
            });
        });
    } else {
      this.tiendaService.agregarItem(payload)
        .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
        .subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.recargarItems();
            this.messageService.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Agregado', detail: `${producto.descripcion} agregado al carrito` });
          },
          error: () => {
            this.messageService.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo agregar al carrito' });
            this.cargandoCarrito.set(false);
          },
        });
    }
  }

  async crearCarrito() {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      this.tiendaService.crearCarrito('Cliente Tienda', '', 'Tienda Virtual', 1)
        .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
        .subscribe({
          next: (carrito) => {
            this.carritoId.set(carrito.poscotmaeId);
            resolve();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.messageService.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo crear el carrito' });
            resolve();
          },
        });
    });
  }

  recargarItems() {
    if (!this.carritoId()) return;
    this.tiendaService.getCarritoItems(this.carritoId()!)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (items) => {
          this.carritoItems.set(items);
          this.cargandoCarrito.set(false);
        },
        error: () => this.cargandoCarrito.set(false),
      });
  }

  incrementar(item: CarritoItem) {
    const prod = this.productos().find(p => p.produtoId === Number(item.productoId));
    if (prod && Number(item.cantidad) >= prod.existencia) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Stock insuficiente', detail: `Solo quedan ${prod.existencia} unidades` });
      return;
    }
    const precio = Number(item.precio);
    const nuevaCant = Number(item.cantidad) + 1;
    this.tiendaService.eliminarItem(item.poscotdetId)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe(() => {
        this.tiendaService.agregarItem({
          poscotmaeId: this.carritoId()!,
          productoId: item.productoId,
          codbarra: item.codbarra,
          cantidad: nuevaCant,
          precio,
          subTotal: precio * nuevaCant,
        }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe(() => this.recargarItems());
      });
  }

  decrementar(item: CarritoItem) {
    if (Number(item.cantidad) <= 1) {
      this.eliminarDelCarrito(item);
      return;
    }
    const precio = Number(item.precio);
    const nuevaCant = Number(item.cantidad) - 1;
    this.tiendaService.eliminarItem(item.poscotdetId)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe(() => {
        this.tiendaService.agregarItem({
          poscotmaeId: this.carritoId()!,
          productoId: item.productoId,
          codbarra: item.codbarra,
          cantidad: nuevaCant,
          precio,
          subTotal: precio * nuevaCant,
        }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe(() => this.recargarItems());
      });
  }

  eliminarDelCarrito(item: CarritoItem) {
    this.tiendaService.eliminarItem(item.poscotdetId)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe(() => this.recargarItems());
  }

  abrirCheckout() {
    if (this.carritoItems().length === 0) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Carrito vacío', detail: 'Agrega productos antes de pagar' });
      return;
    }
    this.checkout = {
      poscotmaeId: this.carritoId()!,
      nombrecliente: 'Cliente Tienda',
      direccion: '',
      formapagoId: 2,
      efectivo_recibido: this.totalCarrito(),
      nrotarjeta: '',
      tarjetacreditoId: this.tarjetasCredito().length > 0 ? this.tarjetasCredito()[0].value : undefined,
      fechaexpiracion: '',
      cvv: '',
    };
    this.dialogCheckout.set(true);
  }

  procesarPago() {
    if (!this.checkout.nombrecliente) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Campo requerido', detail: 'Ingresa el nombre del cliente' });
      return;
    }
    if (!this.checkout.nrotarjeta || this.checkout.nrotarjeta.replace(/\s/g, '').length < 13) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Campo requerido', detail: 'Ingresa el número de tarjeta completo' });
      return;
    }
    if (!this.validarLuhn(this.checkout.nrotarjeta)) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Tarjeta inválida', detail: 'El número de tarjeta no es válido' });
      return;
    }
    if (!this.checkout.fechaexpiracion || !/^\d{2}\/\d{2}$/.test(this.checkout.fechaexpiracion)) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Campo requerido', detail: 'Ingresa la fecha de expiración (MM/YY)' });
      return;
    }
    if (!this.checkout.cvv || this.checkout.cvv.length < 3) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Campo requerido', detail: 'Ingresa el CVV (mínimo 3 dígitos)' });
      return;
    }
    if (!this.checkout.tarjetacreditoId) {
      this.messageService.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Campo requerido', detail: 'Selecciona el tipo de tarjeta' });
      return;
    }

    this.procesando.set(true);
    this.tiendaService.checkout({
      poscotmaeId: this.checkout.poscotmaeId,
      nombrecliente: this.checkout.nombrecliente,
      direccion: this.checkout.direccion,
      formapagoId: 2,
      efectivo_recibido: this.totalCarrito(),
      tarjetacreditoId: this.checkout.tarjetacreditoId,
      nrotarjeta: this.checkout.nrotarjeta,
    })
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (resp) => {
          this.messageService.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Venta procesada',
            detail: `Factura #${resp.nrofactura} — Total: L ${resp.total.toFixed(2)}`,
          });
          this.limpiarTodo();
          this.tiendaService.invalidateCache();
          this.procesando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.messageService.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo procesar el pago' });
          this.procesando.set(false);
        },
      });
  }

  limpiarTodo() {
    this.carritoItems.set([]);
    this.carritoId.set(null);
    this.dialogCheckout.set(false);
  }

  resolverImagen(imagen: string | null): string {
    if (!imagen) return '';
    return /^data:/i.test(imagen) ? imagen : `data:image/png;base64,${imagen}`;
  }

  getItemImagen(item: CarritoItem): string {
    if (item.imagen) return this.resolverImagen(item.imagen);
    const prod = this.productos().find(p => p.produtoId === Number(item.productoId));
    return prod?.imagen ? this.resolverImagen(prod.imagen) : '';
  }

  formatearPrecio(precio: number | string): string {
    return `L ${Number(precio).toFixed(2)}`;
  }

  validarLuhn(numero: string): boolean {
    const digits = numero.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (digits.length < 13 || digits.length > 19) return false;
    let suma = 0;
    let alternar = false;
    for (let i = digits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      let digito = parseInt(digits[i], 10);
      if (alternar) {
        digito *= 2;
        if (digito > 9) digito = Math.floor(digito / 10) + (digito % 10);
      }
      suma += digito;
      alternar = !alternar;
    }
    return suma % 10 === 0;
  }

  getSeverity(stock: number): 'secondary' | 'warn' | 'danger' {
    if (stock > 26) return 'secondary';
    if (stock > 5 && stock <=25) return 'warn';
    return 'danger';
  }

  isMobile(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
  }

  validarTarjetaBlur() {
    const valor = this.checkout.nrotarjeta?.replace(/\s/g, '');
    if (!valor) {
      this.tarjetaError.set(null);
      return;
    }
    if (valor.length < 13) {
      this.tarjetaError.set('El número de tarjeta debe tener al menos 13 dígitos');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.validarLuhn(valor)) {
      this.tarjetaError.set('El número de tarjeta no es válido');
      return;
    }
    this.tarjetaError.set(null);
  }

  trackByProductoId = (_: number, p: ProductoTienda) => p.produtoId;
  trackByItemId = (_: number, i: CarritoItem) => i.poscotdetId;
}
```

```typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, of, tap, shareReplay } from 'rxjs';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { ProductoTienda, Carrito, CarritoItem, CheckoutPago, CheckoutResponse } from '../../../core/models/tienda.models';

const PRODUCTOS_CACHE_KEY = 'tienda_productos_v1';
const PRODUCTOS_CACHE_TTL = 60 * 1000; // 1 minuto

interface ProductosCache {
  data: ProductoTienda[];
  timestamp: number;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class TiendaService {
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private productosCache$: Observable<ProductoTienda[]> | null = null;

  getProductos(forceRefresh = false): Observable<ProductoTienda[]> {
    if (forceRefresh) {
      this.invalidateCache();
    }

    if (this.productosCache$) return this.productosCache$;

    const cached = this.leerCache();
    if (cached) {
      this.productosCache$ = of(cached).pipe(shareReplay(1));
      return this.productosCache$;
    }

    this.productosCache$ = this.api.get<ProductoTienda[]>('/inventario/tienda/productos').pipe(
      tap(data => this.escribirCache(data)),
      shareReplay(1),
    );
    return this.productosCache$;
  }

  invalidateCache() {
    this.productosCache$ = null;
    try { localStorage.removeItem(PRODUCTOS_CACHE_KEY); } catch {}
  }

  private leerCache(): ProductoTienda[] | null {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(PRODUCTOS_CACHE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return null;
      const cache: ProductosCache = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Date.now() - cache.timestamp > PRODUCTOS_CACHE_TTL) {
        localStorage.removeItem(PRODUCTOS_CACHE_KEY);
        return null;
      }
      return cache.data;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private escribirCache(data: ProductoTienda[]) {
    try {
      const cache: ProductosCache = { data, timestamp: Date.now() };
      localStorage.setItem(PRODUCTOS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cache));
    } catch {}
  }

  crearCarrito(nombre: string, direccion: string, atendio: string, gestorId: number): Observable<Carrito> {
    return this.api.post<Carrito>('/facturacion/cotizaciones', {
      Nombrecliente: nombre,
      direccion: direccion || 'N/A',
      atendio,
      gestorId,
    });
  }

  agregarItem(payload: {
    poscotmaeId: number;
    productoId: string;
    codbarra: string;
    cantidad: number;
    precio: number;
    subTotal: number;
  }): Observable<CarritoItem> {
    return this.api.post<CarritoItem>('/facturacion/cotizaciones-det', payload);
  }

  getCarritoItems(maeId: number): Observable<CarritoItem[]> {
    return this.api.get<CarritoItem[]>(`/facturacion/cotizaciones-det/mae/${maeId}`);
  }

  eliminarItem(detId: number): Observable<any> {
    return this.api.delete<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones-det', detId);
  }

  eliminarCarrito(maeId: number): Observable<any> {
    return this.api.delete<any>('/facturacion/cotizaciones', maeId);
  }

  checkout(pago: CheckoutPago): Observable<CheckoutResponse> {
    return this.api.post<CheckoutResponse>('/facturacion/tienda/checkout', pago, { sinContexto: true });
  }
}
```

```typescript
      </ng-template>

  `,
})
export class ClientesHelperList implements OnInit {
  clientes = signal<CxcCliente[]>([]);
  allClientes = signal<CxcCliente[]>([]);
  q = '';

  constructor(
    private cxcService: CxcService,
    private ref: DynamicDialogRef
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.cxcService.getClientes(1, 500).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.allClientes.set(res.data);
        this.clientes.set(res.data);
      },
    });
  }

  buscar() {
    const term = this.q.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!term) {
      this.clientes.set(this.allClientes());
      return;
    }
    this.clientes.set(
      this.allClientes().filter(
        (c) =>
          (c.nrocliente ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.nombres ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.apellidos ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.dni ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (c.rtn ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(term)
      )
    );
  }

  selectCliente(cliente: CxcCliente) {
    this.ref.close(cliente);
  }

  closeDialog(data: any) {
    this.ref.close(data);
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\helpers\entity-selector.ts

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, signal, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef, DynamicDialog } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { FooterHelper } from './footer';

export interface EntityColumn {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  format?: (item: any) => string;
}

export interface EntitySelectorConfig {
  titulo: string;
  columns: EntityColumn[];
  loadData: () => Promise<any[]> | any;
  onSelect?: (item: any) => void;
}

@Component({
  providers: [MessageService],
  standalone: true,
  imports: [TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, FormsModule],
  template: `
    <div class="mb-3">
      <input pInputText [(ngModel)]="q" (keyup.enter)="buscar()" placeholder="Buscar..." class="w-full" />
    </div>
    <p-table
      [value]="items()"
      [rows]="10"
      [paginator]="true"
      responsiveLayout="scroll"
    >
      <ng-template pTemplate="header">
        <tr>
          @for (col of columns; track col.key) {
            <th>{{ col.label }}</th>
          }
          <th style="width:4em"></th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-item>
        <tr>
          @for (col of columns; track col.key) {
            <td>{{ col.format ? col.format(item) : item[col.key] }}</td>
          }
          <td>
            <p-button
              type="button"
              [text]="true"
              [rounded]="true"
              icon="pi pi-plus"
              (onClick)="selectItem(item)"
            />
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  `,
})
export class EntitySelectorHelper implements OnInit {
  @Input() config!: EntitySelectorConfig;

  items = signal<any[]>([]);
  allItems: any[] = [];
  columns: EntityColumn[] = [];
  q = '';

  instance: DynamicDialog | undefined;

  constructor(
    private dialogService: DialogService,
    private ref: DynamicDialogRef
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.instance = this.dialogService.getInstance(this.ref);
    if (this.instance?.data) {
      this.config = this.instance.data['config'];
    }
    this.columns = this.config?.columns ?? [];

    const result = this.config?.loadData();
    if (result instanceof Promise) {
      result.then((data) => this.setItems(data));
    } else if (result) {
      if (Array.isArray(result)) {
        this.setItems(result);
      } else if (result.subscribe) {
        result.subscribe((data: any) => this.setItems(data));
      }
    }
  }

  private setItems(data: any[]) {
    this.allItems = data ?? [];
    this.items.set(this.allItems);
  }

  buscar() {
    const term = this.q.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!term) {
      this.items.set(this.allItems);
      return;
    }
    this.items.set(
      this.allItems.filter((item) =>
        this.columns.some((col) => {
          const val = String(item[col.key] ?? '').toLowerCase();
          return val.includes(term);
        })
      )
    );
  }

  selectItem(item: any) {
    this.config?.onSelect?.(item);
    this.ref.close(item);
  }

  closeDialog(data: any) {
    this.ref.close(data);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, signal, computed } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InfoHelper } from './info';
import { ProductosService } from '../../core/services/productos.service';
import { Producto } from '../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  providers: [DialogService, MessageService, ProductosService],
  standalone: true,
  imports: [TableModule, ButtonModule, FormsModule, InputTextModule],
  template: `
    <p-table
      dataKey="produtoId"
      [value]="productosFiltrados()"
      responsiveLayout="scroll"
       [filterDelay]="200"
      [rows]="5"
      [paginator]="true"
    >
      <ng-template pTemplate="header">
        <tr>
          <th pSortableColumn="codbarra">
            <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
              Código
              <p-sortIcon field="codbarra"></p-sortIcon>
            </div>
          </th>
          <th pSortableColumn="descripcion">
            <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
              Descripción
              <p-sortIcon field="descripcion"></p-sortIcon>
            </div>
          </th>
          <th pSortableColumn="precioventa" style="width: 12rem" class="text-right">
            <div class="flex align-items-center justify-content-end gap-2">
              Precio Venta
              <p-sortIcon field="precioventa"></p-sortIcon>
            </div>
          </th>
          <th style="width: 4em"></th>
        </tr>
        <tr class="filtros-row">
          <th>
            <input
              pInputText
              type="text"
              [ngModel]="filtroCodbarra()"
              (ngModelChange)="filtroCodbarra.set($event)"
              placeholder="Filtrar código"
              class="w-full"
            />
          </th>
          <th>
            <input
              pInputText
              type="text"
              [ngModel]="filtroDescripcion()"
              (ngModelChange)="filtroDescripcion.set($event)"
              placeholder="Filtrar descripción"
              class="w-full"
            />
          </th>
          <th></th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-product>
        <tr (click)="selectProduct(product)" class="row-selectable">
          <td>{{ product.codbarra }}</td>
          <td>{{ product.descripcion }}</td>
          <td class="text-right">{{ product.precioventa }}</td>
          <td>
            <p-button
              type="button"
              [text]="true"
              [rounded]="true"
              severity="success"
              icon="pi pi-chevron-circle-right"
              (click)="selectProduct(product); $event.stopPropagation()"
            />
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
        <tr>
          <td colspan="4" class="text-center p-3">Sin resultados</td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  `,
})
export class ProductosHelperList implements OnInit {
  products = signal<Producto[]>([]);

  filtroCodbarra = signal('');
  filtroDescripcion = signal('');

  productosFiltrados = computed(() => {
    const cod = this.filtroCodbarra().toLowerCase().trim();
    const desc = this.filtroDescripcion().toLowerCase().trim();
    return this.products().filter(
      (p) =>
        (!cod || (p.codbarra ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(cod)) &&
        (!desc || (p.descripcion ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(desc)),
    );
  });

  constructor(
    private productService: ProductosService,
    private dialogService: DialogService,
    private ref: DynamicDialogRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.productService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (products: Producto[]) => {
        this.products.set(products);
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar productos', error);
      },
    });
  }

  selectProduct(product: Producto) {
    this.ref.close(product);
  }

  showInfo() {
    this.dialogService.open(InfoHelper, {
      header: 'Información',
      modal: true,
      dismissableMask: true,
      data: {
        totalItems: this.products().length,
      },
    });
  }

  closeDialog(data) {
    this.ref.close(data);
  }
}
```

```typescript
    <header class="page-header">
      <div>
        <h3 class="page-title">Ajuste de Inventarios</h3>
        <p class="page-subtitle">Entradas y salidas de productos por ajuste directo</p>
      </div>
      <p-button label="Nuevo Ajuste" icon="pi pi-plus" size="small" rounded (onClick)="nuevoMae()" />
    </header>

    <p-table [value]="ajustes()" [loading]="cargando()" dataKey="invmovmaeid" [paginator]="true" [rows]="10"
      [showCurrentPageReport]="true" currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
      [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]" size="small">
      <ng-template pTemplate="header">
        <tr>
          <th style="width:4rem">#</th>
          <th>Fecha</th>
          <th>Bodega</th>
          <th>Concepto</th>
          <th style="width:7rem">Tipo</th>
          <th style="width:6rem">Estado</th>
          <th style="width:6rem">Creado por</th>
          <th style="width:4rem"></th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
        <tr (click)="seleccionar(row)" style="cursor:pointer">
          <td>{{ row.invmovmaeid }}</td>
          <td>{{ row.fecharegistro | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
          <td>{{ nombreBodega(row.bodegaId) }}</td>
          <td>{{ row.concepto }}</td>
          <td>
            <p-tag [value]="row.sn_entrada === 'S' ? 'Entrada' : 'Salida'" [severity]="row.sn_entrada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
          </td>
          <td>
            <p-tag [value]="row.sn_anulado === 'S' ? 'Anulado' : 'Activo'" [severity]="row.sn_anulado === 'S' ? 'danger' : 'info'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
          </td>
          <td>{{ row.usuarioCreated }}</td>
          <td>
            <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" text size="small" rounded
              (onClick)="$event.stopPropagation(); seleccionar(row)" [disabled]="row.sn_anulado === 'S'" />
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
        <tr>
          <td colspan="8" class="text-center p-3">No hay ajustes de inventario registrados.</td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  }

  @if (seleccionado()) {
    <header class="page-header">
      <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <p-button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="volver()" />
        <div>
          <h3 class="page-title">Ajuste #{{ seleccionado()!.invmovmaeid || 'Nuevo' }}</h3>
          <p class="page-subtitle">
            {{ formMae.value.concepto || 'Sin concepto' }}
            — {{ nombreBodega(formMae.value.bodegaId || 0) || 'Sin bodega' }}
            — <p-tag [value]="formMae.value.sn_entrada === 'S' ? 'Entrada' : 'Salida'" [severity]="formMae.value.sn_entrada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.7rem'}" />
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        @if (seleccionado()!.invmovmaeid && seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'N') {
          @if (!todosProcesados()) {
            <p-button label="Procesar" icon="pi pi-check-circle" size="small" rounded severity="success" (onClick)="procesar()"
              [disabled]="detalles().length === 0" />
          }
        }
      </div>
    </header>

    <form [formGroup]="formMae" (ngSubmit)="guardarMae()" class="card form-card">
      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="campo">
          <label>Bodega *</label>
          <p-select formControlName="bodegaId" [options]="bodegas()" optionLabel="descripcion"
            optionValue="bodegaId" placeholder="Seleccionar bodega" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'"
            [disabled]="!esNuevo()" />
          @if (formMae.get('bodegaId')?.invalid && formMae.get('bodegaId')?.touched) {
            <small class="err">Requerido</small>
          }
        </div>
        <div class="campo">
          <label>Tipo de Movimiento *</label>
          <p-select formControlName="sn_entrada" [options]="[{label:'Entrada de producto', value:'S'},{label:'Salida de producto', value:'N'}]"
            optionLabel="label" optionValue="value" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'"
            [disabled]="!esNuevo()" />
        </div>
        <div class="campo campo-full">
          <label>Concepto *</label>
          <input pInputText formControlName="concepto" placeholder="Ej: Ajuste por merma" [readonly]="!esNuevo()" class="w-full" />
          @if (formMae.get('concepto')?.invalid && formMae.get('concepto')?.touched) {
            <small class="err">Requerido</small>
          }
        </div>
      </div>
      @if (esNuevo()) {
        <div class="acciones-form">
          <p-button type="button" label="Cancelar" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="volver()" />
          <p-button type="submit" label="Crear Ajuste" icon="pi pi-check" size="small" rounded severity="success" [raised]="true"
            [loading]="guardando()" [disabled]="formMae.invalid" />
        </div>
      }
    </form>

    <div class="card info-card">
      <div class="info-grid">
        <div><span class="info-label">Estado:</span>
          <p-tag [value]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'S' ? 'Anulado' : 'Activo'" [severity]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'S' ? 'danger' : 'info'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.7rem'}" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    @if (seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'N' && !todosProcesados()) {
      <div [formGroup]="formDet" class="card agregar-item-card">
          <div class="agregar-item-row">
            <div class="campo campo-codbarra">
              <label>Codigo de Barras</label>
              <div class="flex gap-1">
                <input pInputText [ngModel]="codBusqueda()" (ngModelChange)="onCodBarraInput($event)"
                  (keyup.enter)="buscarProducto()" placeholder="Escanear o escribir codigo..." [ngModelOptions]="{standalone: true}" />
                <p-button icon="pi pi-search" size="small" rounded severity="secondary" (onClick)="showHelperProductos()" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="campo campo-cantidad">
              <label>Cantidad</label>
              <p-inputNumber formControlName="cantidad" [min]="0.01" mode="decimal" [minFractionDigits]="2"
                [maxFractionDigits]="2" size="small" [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }" styleClass="w-full" />
            </div>
            <div class="campo campo-costo">
              <label>Costo U.</label>
              <p-inputNumber formControlName="costoUnitario" [min]="0" mode="currency" currency="HNL" [locale]="'es-HN'"
                [minFractionDigits]="2" [maxFractionDigits]="2" [useGrouping]="true" size="small"
                [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }" styleClass="w-full" [readonly]="true" />
            </div>
            <div class="campo-btn">
              <p-button icon="pi pi-plus" size="small" rounded severity="success" (onClick)="buscarProducto(); agregarItem()"
                [loading]="guardando()" [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'S' || todosProcesados()" />
            </div>
          </div>
          @if (formDet.value.descripcion) {
            <div class="producto-encontrado">
              <span class="font-bold">{{ formDet.value.descripcion }}</span>
              <span class="text-sm text-color-secondary"> | Costo: {{ moneda(formDet.value.costoUnitario) }}</span>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <select [ngModel]="formDet.value.productoId" (ngModelChange)="formDet.patchValue({productoId: $event})" [ngModelOptions]="{standalone: true}" class="hidden-select">
          <option [ngValue]="null">-</option>
          @for (p of productos(); track p.produtoId) {
            <option [ngValue]="p.produtoId">{{ p.descripcion }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      }

      <p-table [value]="detalles()" [loading]="cargandoDet()" dataKey="invmovdetid" [paginator]="true" [rows]="15" size="small">
        <ng-template pTemplate="header">
          <tr>
            <th style="width:3rem">#</th>
            <th>Cod. Barra</th>
            <th>Producto</th>
            <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Cantidad</th>
            <th style="width:8rem" class="text-right">Costo U.</th>
            <th style="width:8rem" class="text-right">Total</th>
            <th style="width:6rem" class="text-center">Estado</th>
            @if (seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'N' && !todosProcesados()) {
              <th style="width:5rem" class="text-center"></th>
            }
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
          <tr>
            <td>{{ row.nrofila }}</td>
            <td class="font-bold">{{ row.codbarra }}</td>
            <td>{{ row.descripcion }}</td>
            <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ row.cantidad }}</td>
            <td class="text-right">{{ moneda(row.costoUnitario) }}</td>
            <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ moneda(row.costoTotal) }}</td>
            <td class="text-center">
              @if (row.verificador === 1) {
                <p-tag value="Procesado" severity="success" [style]="{'font-size':'0.7rem'}" />
              } @else {
                <p-tag value="Pendiente" severity="warn" [style]="{'font-size':'0.7rem'}" />
              }
            </td>
            @if (seleccionado()!.sn_anulado === 'N' && !todosProcesados()) {
              <td class="text-center">
                <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" text severity="danger" size="small" rounded (onClick)="eliminarItem(row)"
                  [disabled]="row.verificador === 1" />
              </td>
            }
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
          <tr>
            <td colspan="8" class="text-center p-3">No hay items en este ajuste.</td>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
      </p-table>
  }
</section>
```

```typescript
.form-card {
  max-width: 800px;
}

.form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1rem 2rem;

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.campo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;

  label {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--c-text-muted, #64748b);
  }
}

.campo-full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.acciones-form {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border, #e2e8f0);
}

.req { color: var(--c-error, #ef4444); }
.err { color: var(--c-error, #ef4444); font-size: 0.75rem; }
.hidden-select { display: none; }

/* Info card */
.info-card {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.info-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.5rem 2rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.info-label {
  color: var(--c-text-muted, #64748b);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Agregar item */
.agregar-item-card {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.agregar-item-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.campo-codbarra { flex: 3; }
.campo-cantidad { flex: 1; min-width: 100px; }
.campo-costo { flex: 1; min-width: 100px; }
.campo-btn { flex: 0; padding-bottom: 0.15rem; }

.producto-encontrado {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  background: var(--c-surface-ground, #f8fafc);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border, #e2e8f0);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .page-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  .agregar-item-row {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .campo-codbarra,
  .campo-cantidad,
  .campo-costo {
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    min-width: 100%;
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\ajustes\ajustes.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef, ChangeDetectionStrategy } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { AjusteInventarioService } from '../../../core/services/ajuste-inventario.service';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { ProductosService } from '../../../core/services/productos.service';
import { Bodega, Producto } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';
import { ProductosHelperList } from '../../helpers/productos';
import { FooterHelper } from '../../helpers/footer';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-ajustes',
  standalone: true,
  providers: [DialogService],
  imports: [
    CommonModule, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule,
    TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule, TagModule, ToastModule, ConfirmDialogModule, TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './ajustes.html',
  styleUrl: './ajustes.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class Ajustes implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private service = inject(AjusteInventarioService);
  private bodegasService = inject(BodegasService);
  private productosService = inject(ProductosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private dialogService = inject(DialogService);

  ref: DynamicDialogRef | undefined;

  ajustes = signal<any[]>([]);
  detalles = signal<any[]>([]);
  bodegas = signal<Bodega[]>([]);
  productos = signal<Producto[]>([]);

  seleccionado = signal<any | null>(null);
  cargando = signal(false);
  cargandoDet = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);

  codBusqueda = signal('');

  formMae = this.fb.group({
    concepto: ['', Validators.required],
    bodegaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    sn_entrada: ['S' as 'S' | 'N', Validators.required],
  });

  formDet = this.fb.group({
    codbarra: ['', Validators.required],
    productoId: [null as number | null],
    descripcion: [''],
    cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    costoUnitario: [0],
  });

  ngOnInit() {
    this.cargarAjustes();
    this.cargarBodegas();
    this.cargarProductos();
  }

  cargarAjustes() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => { this.ajustes.set(data || []); this.cargando.set(false); },
      error: () => { this.cargando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los ajustes' }); },
    });
  }

  cargarBodegas() {
    this.bodegasService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => this.bodegas.set(data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarProductos() {
    this.productosService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => this.productos.set(data || []),
    });
  }

  seleccionar(ajuste: any) {
    this.seleccionado.set(ajuste);
    this.formMae.patchValue({
      concepto: ajuste.concepto || '',
      bodegaId: ajuste.bodegaId || null,
      sn_entrada: ajuste.sn_entrada || 'S',
    });
    this.cargarDetalles(ajuste.invmovmaeid);
  }

  cargarDetalles(maeId: number) {
    this.cargandoDet.set(true);
    this.service.getDet(maeId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => { this.detalles.set(data || []); this.cargandoDet.set(false); },
      error: () => { this.cargandoDet.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los items' }); },
    });
  }

  volver() {
    this.seleccionado.set(null);
    this.detalles.set([]);
  }

  nuevoMae() {
    this.formMae.reset({ concepto: '', bodegaId: null, sn_entrada: 'S' });
    this.formDet.reset({ codbarra: '', productoId: null, descripcion: '', cantidad: 1, costoUnitario: 0 });
    this.codBusqueda.set('');
    this.detalles.set([]);
    this.seleccionado.set({ invmovmaeid: 0, sn_procesado: 'N', sn_anulado: 'N', concepto: '', bodegaId: 0 });
  }

  guardarMae() {
    if (this.formMae.invalid) return;
    const val = this.formMae.value;
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service.create({
      concepto: val.concepto || '',
      bodegaId: val.bodegaId || 0,
      sn_entrada: val.sn_entrada || 'S',
    }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Creado', detail: 'Ajuste creado' });
        this.seleccionado.set(res);
        this.cargarAjustes();
      },
      error: (err) => { this.guardando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo crear' }); },
    });
  }

  onCodBarraInput(valor: string) {
    this.codBusqueda.set(valor);
    if (valor.length >= 12) {
      this.buscarProducto();
    }
  }

  buscarProducto() {
    const q = this.codBusqueda().trim();
    if (!q) return;
    const prod = this.productos().find(p => p.codbarra === q);
    if (prod) {
      this.formDet.patchValue({
        productoId: prod.produtoId,
        codbarra: prod.codbarra,
        descripcion: prod.descripcion,
        costoUnitario: prod.cstounit || 0,
      });
    } else {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'No encontrado', detail: 'Producto no encontrado por código de barras' });
    }
  }

  showHelperProductos() {
    this.ref = this.dialogService.open(ProductosHelperList, {
      header: 'Seleccionar un producto',
      width: '50vw',
      modal: true,
      contentStyle: { overflow: 'auto' },
      breakpoints: { '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' },
      templates: { footer: FooterHelper },
    });
    this.ref.onClose.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe((data: any) => {
      if (data && 'codbarra' in data) {
        this.agregarDirecto(data);
      }
    });
  }

  agregarDirecto(prod: any) {
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae || !mae.invmovmaeid) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atención', detail: 'Primero guarde el encabezado del ajuste' });
      return;
    }
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service.createDet({
      invmovmaeid: mae.invmovmaeid,
      bodegaId: mae.bodegaId,
      codbarra: prod.codbarra,
      cantidad: 1,
      sn_entrada: mae.sn_entrada || 'S',
      empresaId: mae.empresaId,
    }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Agregado', detail: prod.descripcion });
        this.cargarDetalles(mae.invmovmaeid);
      },
      error: (err) => { this.guardando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo agregar' }); },
    });
  }

  agregarItem() {
    if (this.formDet.invalid) return;
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae || !mae.invmovmaeid) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atención', detail: 'Primero guarde el encabezado del ajuste' });
      return;
    }
    const val = this.formDet.value;
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service.createDet({
      invmovmaeid: mae.invmovmaeid,
      bodegaId: mae.bodegaId,
      codbarra: val.codbarra || '',
      cantidad: val.cantidad || 0,
      sn_entrada: mae.sn_entrada || 'S',
    }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Agregado', detail: 'Item agregado' });
        this.formDet.reset({ codbarra: '', productoId: null, descripcion: '', cantidad: 1, costoUnitario: 0 });
        this.codBusqueda.set('');
        this.cargarDetalles(mae.invmovmaeid);
      },
      error: (err) => { this.guardando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo agregar' }); },
    });
  }

  eliminarItem(row: any) {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar item "${row.descripcion || row.codbarra}"?`,
      header: 'Confirmar',
      acceptLabel: 'Eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.removeDet(row.invmovdetid).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Eliminado' });
            this.cargarDetalles(this.seleccionado()!.invmovmaeid);
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo eliminar' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => this.confirm.close(),
    });
  }

  procesar() {
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae) return;
    const tipo = mae.sn_entrada === 'S' ? 'entrada' : 'salida';
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Procesar ajuste #${mae.invmovmaeid}? Se registrará como ${tipo} en kardex.`,
      header: 'Procesar ajuste',
      acceptLabel: 'Procesar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.procesar(mae.invmovmaeid).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (res) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Procesado', detail: res?.message || 'Ajuste procesado' });
            this.cargarAjustes();
            this.cargarDetalles(mae.invmovmaeid);
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo procesar' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => this.confirm.close(),
    });
  }

  todosProcesados(): boolean {
    return this.detalles().length > 0 && this.detalles().every(d => d.verificador === 1);
  }

  esNuevo(): boolean {
    return !this.seleccionado()?.invmovmaeid;
  }

  nombreBodega(id: number): string {
    return this.bodegas().find(b => b.bodegaId === id)?.descripcion || `Bodega ${id}`;
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }
}

```

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-bodega-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './bodega-form.html',
  styleUrl: './bodega-form.scss',
})
export class BodegaForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(BodegasService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nueva bodega');

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private bodegaId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar bodega');
      this.bodegaId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.bodegaId).subscribe({
        next: (c) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: c.descripcion,
            sn_activo: c.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Bodega no encontrada' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.bodegaId, payload as any)
      : this.service.create(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Bodega actualizada' : 'Bodega creada correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar la bodega',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
    <p-button
      label="Nueva bodega"
      icon="pi pi-plus"
      size="small"
      variant="text"
      [raised]="true"
      [rounded]="true"
      severity="success"
      (onClick)="nuevo()" />
  </header>

  <div class="filtros card">
    <div class="campo">
      <label>Buscar</label>
      <!-- Se aplica el estándar para inputs (pSize y class="w-full") -->
      <input
        pInputText
        pSize="small"
        class="w-full"
        type="text"
        placeholder="Descripción..."
        [ngModel]="q()"
        (ngModelChange)="q.set($event)"
        (keyup.enter)="buscar()"
      />
    </div>
    <div class="campo acciones">
      <p-button
        label="Buscar"
        icon="pi pi-search"
        size="small"
        [rounded]="true"
        (onClick)="buscar()" />

        label="Limpiar"

        severity="secondary"
        variant="text"
        size="small"
        [rounded]="true"
        (onClick)="limpiarFiltros()"
      />
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Propiedad 'layout="list"' forzada para evitar el modo grid por defecto -->
  <p-dataview
    #dv
    [value]="filtered()"
    [loading]="cargando()"
    dataKey="bodegaId"
    layout="list"
    [paginator]="true"
    [rows]="20"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
    currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
  >
    <ng-template #list let-items>
      <div class="dv-cards">
        @for (c of items; track c.bodegaId) {
          <div class="dv-card">
            <div class="dv-top">
              <span class="dv-title">{{ c.descripcion }}</span>
              <p-tag [value]="activoLbl(c.sn_activo)" [severity]="activoSev(c.sn_activo)" />
            </div>

            <div class="dv-body">
              <div class="dv-row">
                <span class="dv-label">ID</span>
                <span class="dv-value">{{ c.bodegaId }}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dv-actions" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
              <!-- Botón de edición estandarizado -->
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-pencil"
                pTooltip="Editar"
                severity="warn"
                variant="text"
                size="small"
                [rounded]="true"
                (onClick)="editar(c.bodegaId, $event)"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </ng-template>

    <!-- En PrimeNG 18 el template vacío correcto es #empty (no #emptymessage) -->
    <ng-template #empty>
      <div class="text-center p-4">No hay bodegas que coincidan con los filtros.</div>
    </ng-template>
  </p-dataview>
</section>
```

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { Bodega } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-bodegas',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './bodegas.html',
  styleUrl: './bodegas.scss',
})
export class Bodegas implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(BodegasService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Bodega[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Bodega[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las bodegas',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((c) => !q || c.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { CasasService } from '../../../core/services/casas.service';
import { Casa } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-casas',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './casas.html',
  styleUrl: './casas.scss',
})
export class Casas implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(CasasService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Casa[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Casa[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las casas',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((c) => !q || c.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\catalogo-list\catalogo-list.ts

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { CatalogoParametrosService } from '../../../core/services/catalogo-parametros.service';

export interface CampoColumna {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface CatalogoConfig {
  titulo: string;
  subtitulo: string;
  ruta: string;
  idKey: string;
  icono: string;
  tituloNuevo: string;
  campos: CampoColumna[];
  sinEstado?: boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogo-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule],
  templateUrl: './catalogo-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogo-list.scss',
})
export class CatalogoList implements OnInit {
  private catalogoService = inject(CatalogoParametrosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  config = signal<CatalogoConfig>({
    titulo: '',
    subtitulo: '',
    ruta: '',
    idKey: '',
    icono: '',
    tituloNuevo: '',
    campos: [],
  });

  data = signal<any[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<any[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  busqueda = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.route.paramMap.subscribe(() => {
      const data = this.route.snapshot.data?.['catalogo'] as CatalogoConfig;
      if (data) {
        this.config.set(data);
      }
      this.busqueda.set('');
      this.load();
    });
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.catalogoService.getAll<any>(this.config().ruta).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: `No se pudieron cargar ${this.config().titulo}`,
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.busqueda().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((item) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return this.config().campos.some(
          (c) => String(item?.[c.key] ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.busqueda.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id: number) {
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}

```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\categorias\categoria-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { CategoriasService } from '../../../core/services/categorias.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-categoria-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    SelectButtonModule,
    SelectModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './categoria-form.html',
  styleUrl: './categoria-form.scss',
})
export class CategoriaForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(CategoriasService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nueva categoría');

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private categoriaId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar categoría');
      this.categoriaId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.categoriaId).subscribe({
        next: (c) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: c.descripcion,
            sn_activo: c.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Categoría no encontrada' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.categoriaId, payload as any)
      : this.service.create(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Categoría actualizada' : 'Categoría creada correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar la categoría',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
          rounded
          (onClick)="volver()"
        />
        <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" rounded size="small" [loading]="guardando()" />
      </div>
    </form>
  }
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\colores\color-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ColoresService } from '../../../core/services/colores.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-color-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './color-form.html',
  styleUrl: './color-form.scss',
})
export class ColorForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(ColoresService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo color');

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private colorId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar color');
      this.colorId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.colorId).subscribe({
        next: (c) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: c.descripcion,
            sn_activo: c.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Color no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.colorId, payload as any)
      : this.service.create(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Color actualizado' : 'Color creado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar el color',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\colores\colores.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ColoresService } from '../../../core/services/colores.service';
import { Color } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-colores',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './colores.html',
  styleUrl: './colores.scss',
})
export class Colores implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(ColoresService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Color[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Color[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los colores',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((c) => !q || c.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
<p-toast />

<section class="page">
  @if (!seleccionado()) {

  </header>

  <p-table [value]="compras()" [loading]="cargando()" dataKey="compraId" [paginator]="true" [rows]="10"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true" currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]" size="small">
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th style="width:4rem">#</th>
        <th>Fecha</th>
        <th>Proveedor</th>
        <th>Bodega</th>
        <th>Ref.</th>

        <th style="width:6rem">Tipo</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Pagada</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Estado</th>
        <th style="width:8rem">Acciones</th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
      <tr (click)="seleccionar(row)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <td>{{ row.compraId }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.fecharegistro | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
        <td>{{ nombreProveedor(row.proveedorId) }}</td>
        <td>{{ nombreBodega(row.bodegaId) }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.nroreferencia || '-' }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ moneda(row.total) }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.TipoCompra === 'FCO' ? 'Contado' : row.TipoCompra === 'FCC' ? 'Crédito' : 'Orden'"
            [severity]="row.TipoCompra === 'FCO' ? 'success' : row.TipoCompra === 'FCC' ? 'info' : 'warn'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No'" [severity]="row.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'warn'"
            [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'Anulada' : 'Activa'"
            [severity]="row.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'danger' : 'success'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" text size="small" rounded
            (onClick)="$event.stopPropagation(); anularCompra(row)" [disabled]="row.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="10" class="text-center p-3">No hay compras registradas.</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>
  } @else {
  <header class="page-header">
    <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
      <p-button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="volver()" />
      <div>
        <h3 class="page-title">Compra #{{ seleccionado()!.compraId }}</h3>
        <p class="page-subtitle">
          {{ nombreProveedor(seleccionado()!.proveedorId) }}
          — {{ nombreBodega(seleccionado()!.bodegaId) }}
          — {{ seleccionado()!.TipoCompra === 'FCO' ? 'Contado' : seleccionado()!.TipoCompra === 'FCC' ? 'Crédito' : 'Orden' }}
        </p>
      </div>

    <div class="flex gap-2">

      <p-button label="Procesar" icon="pi pi-check-circle" size="small" rounded severity="success" (onClick)="procesar()"
        [disabled]="detalles().length === 0 || seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
      <p-button label="Anular" icon="pi pi-times-circle" size="small" rounded severity="danger"
        (onClick)="anularCompra(seleccionado()!)" [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
    </div>
  </header>

  <p-table [value]="detalles()" [loading]="cargandoDet()" dataKey="cxpcomprasdetId" [paginator]="true" [rows]="15"
    size="small">

</section>

<!-- Dialog Nueva Compra -->
<p-dialog header="Nueva Compra" [modal]="true" [draggable]="false" [resizable]="false" [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [style]="{width:'550px', minHeight:'350px'}"
  [(visible)]="dialogMae">

          [filterBy]="'nombres,apellidos,razonsocial'" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'">

          </ng-template>
        </p-select>
```
