## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-mnuitem\usuario-mnuitem.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosMnuItemService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-mnuitem.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';
import { UsuariosMnuItem } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-mnuitem',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-mnuitem.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-mnuitem.scss',
})
export class UsuarioMnuItem implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosMnuItemService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuariosMnuItem[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuariosMnuItem[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');
  private modulosMap = new Map<number, string>();

  ngOnInit() {
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (d) => d.forEach((m) => this.modulosMap.set(m.moduloId, m.descripcion)),
    });
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los items',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        const text = [
          i.usuario,
          i.nameItem,
          i.labelItem,
          i.routerLink ?? '',
          this.getModuloName(i.moduloId),
        ]
          .join(' ')
          .toLowerCase();
        return !q || text.includes(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuariosMnuItem, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar el item "${item.labelItem}" (${item.usuario})? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.tusuariomnuitemsId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Item eliminado correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar el item',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  getModuloName(id: number): string {
    return this.modulosMap.get(id) ?? `#${id}`;
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuarioModAuthService } from '../../../core/services/usuario-modauth.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modauth-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, SelectModule, SelectButtonModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modauth-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modauth-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModAuthForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuarioModAuthService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevos permisos');

  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);

  private recordId = 0;

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Sí', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'No', value: 'N' },
  ];

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_auth_anulaciones: ['N'],
      sn_auth_facturacion: ['N'],
      sn_auth_contabilizar: ['N'],
      sn_auth_devoluciones: ['N'],
      sn_auth_reversion: ['N'],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar permisos');
      this.recordId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.recordId).subscribe({
        next: (r) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            usuario: r.usuario,
            sn_auth_anulaciones: r.sn_auth_anulaciones === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_facturacion: r.sn_auth_facturacion === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_contabilizar: r.sn_auth_contabilizar === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_devoluciones: r.sn_auth_devoluciones === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_reversion: r.sn_auth_reversion === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.form.get('usuario')?.disable();
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Permisos no encontrados' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const dto = {
      usuario: raw.usuario,
      sn_auth_anulaciones: raw.sn_auth_anulaciones,
      sn_auth_facturacion: raw.sn_auth_facturacion,
      sn_auth_contabilizar: raw.sn_auth_contabilizar,
      sn_auth_devoluciones: raw.sn_auth_devoluciones,
      sn_auth_reversion: raw.sn_auth_reversion,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.recordId, dto)
      : this.service.create(dto);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Permisos actualizados' : 'Permisos creados correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron guardar los permisos',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-modauth\usuario-modauth.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuarioModAuthService } from '../../../core/services/usuario-modauth.service';
import { UsuarioModAuth } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modauth',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modauth.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modauth.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModAuthPage implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuarioModAuthService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuarioModAuth[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuarioModAuth[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los permisos',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((p) => {
        return !q || p.usuario.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuarioModAuth, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar los permisos del usuario "${item.usuario}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.usuariomodauthId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Permisos eliminados correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudieron eliminar los permisos',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  snLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No';
  }

  snSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosModuleService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-module.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modulos-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, SelectModule, SelectButtonModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modulos-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modulos-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModulosForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuariosModuleService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nueva asignación de módulo');

  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);
  modulos = signal<{ moduloId: number; descripcion: string }[]>([]);

  private recordId = 0;

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Sí', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'No', value: 'N' },
  ];

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      moduloId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
      submnudatos: ['N'],
      submnurocesos: ['N'],
      submnueportes: ['N'],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.modulos.set(d) });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar asignación de módulo');
      this.recordId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.recordId).subscribe({
        next: (r) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            usuario: r.usuario,
            moduloId: r.moduloId,
            submnudatos: r.submnudatos === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            submnurocesos: r.submnurocesos === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            submnueportes: r.submnueportes === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.form.get('usuario')?.disable();
          this.form.get('moduloId')?.disable();
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Asignación no encontrada' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const data = {
      usuario: raw.usuario,
      moduloId: raw.moduloId,
      submnudatos: raw.submnudatos,
      submnurocesos: raw.submnurocesos,
      submnueportes: raw.submnueportes,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.recordId, {
          submnudatos: data.submnudatos,
          submnurocesos: data.submnurocesos,
          submnueportes: data.submnueportes,
        })
      : this.service.create({ ...data, sn_activo: 'S' });

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Asignación actualizada' : 'Asignación creada correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar la asignación',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
        text
        size="small"
        (onClick)="limpiarFiltros()"
      />
    </div>
  </div>

  <p-table
    [value]="filtered()"
    [loading]="cargando()"
    dataKey="tusuariosmoduloId"
    [paginator]="true"
    [rows]="20"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
    currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
    size="small"
  >
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th>Usuario</th>
        <th>Modulo</th>
        <th style="width:5rem">Datos</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Procesos</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Reportes</th>
        <th style="width:5rem">Estado</th>
        <th style="width:6rem"></th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-i>
      <tr>
        <td class="font-bold">{{ i.usuario }}</td>
        <td>{{ getModuloName(i.moduloId) }}</td>
        <td><p-tag [value]="snLbl(i.submnudatos)" [severity]="snSev(i.submnudatos)" /></td>
        <td><p-tag [value]="snLbl(i.submnurocesos)" [severity]="snSev(i.submnurocesos)" /></td>
        <td><p-tag [value]="snLbl(i.submnueportes)" [severity]="snSev(i.submnueportes)" /></td>
        <td><p-tag [value]="activoLbl(i.sn_activo)" [severity]="activoSev(i.sn_activo)" /></td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-pencil" pTooltip="Editar" (onClick)="editar(i.tusuariosmoduloId, $event)"
            severity="warn" text size="small" rounded class="mr-1" />
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" pTooltip="Eliminar" (onClick)="eliminar(i, $event)"
            severity="danger" text size="small" rounded />

    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center p-3">No hay asignaciones que coincidan con los filtros.</td></tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>
</section>
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosModuleService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-module.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';
import { UsuariosModule } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modulos',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modulos.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modulos.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModulos implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosModuleService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuariosModule[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuariosModule[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');
  private modulosMap = new Map<number, string>();

  ngOnInit() {
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (d) => d.forEach((m) => this.modulosMap.set(m.moduloId, m.descripcion)),
    });
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las asignaciones',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        return (
          !q ||
          i.usuario.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          this.getModuloName(i.moduloId).toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuariosModule, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar la asignación del módulo "${this.getModuloName(item.moduloId)}" al usuario "${item.usuario}"?`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.tusuariosmoduloId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Asignación eliminada correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar la asignación',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  getModuloName(id: number): string {
    return this.modulosMap.get(id) ?? `#${id}`;
  }

  snLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No';
  }

  snSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-roles\usuario-roles-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuarioRolesService } from '../../../core/services/usuario-roles.service';
import { UsuarioRol, TipoRol } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-roles-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-roles-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-roles-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioRolesForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuarioRolesService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Asignar rol');

  usuarios = signal<{ usuarioId: number; usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);
  tiposRol = signal<TipoRol[]>([]);

  private recordId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuarioId: [null, Validators.required],
      rol: ['', Validators.required],
    });

    this.usuariosService
      .getAll()
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d), error: () => {} });

    this.service
      .getTipos()
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({ next: (d) => this.tiposRol.set(d), error: () => {} });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar asignación de rol');
      this.recordId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service
        .getOne(this.recordId)
        .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
        .subscribe({
          next: (r: UsuarioRol) => {
            this.form.patchValue({ usuarioId: r.usuarioId, rol: r.rol });
            // La asignación usuario+rol es única: no se edita el usuario
            this.form.get('usuarioId')?.disable();
            this.cargando.set(false);
          },
          error: () => {
            this.cargando.set(false);
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Asignación no encontrada' });
            this.volver();
          },
        });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const dto: Partial<UsuarioRol> = {
      usuarioId: Number(raw.usuarioId),
      rol: raw.rol,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.recordId, dto)
      : this.service.create(dto);

    op.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Asignación actualizada' : 'Rol asignado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo guardar la asignación de rol',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuarioRolesService } from '../../../core/services/usuario-roles.service';
import { UsuarioRol } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-roles',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule, TooltipModule],
  providers: [MessageService, ConfirmationService],
  templateUrl: './usuario-roles.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-roles.scss',
})
export class UsuarioRolesPage implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuarioRolesService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuarioRol[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuarioRol[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los roles de usuario',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((r) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          (r.nombreUsuario ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (r.loginUsuario ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          r.rol.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuarioRol, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Quitar el rol "${item.rol}" al usuario "${item.loginUsuario || item.usuarioId}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.rol_id).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Rol removido correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: (err) => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo eliminar el rol',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  /** Severidad visual del tag según el rol */
  severidadRol(rol: string): 'danger' | 'warn' | 'info' | 'secondary' {
    switch (rol) {
      case 'admin':
        return 'danger';
      case 'supervisor':
        return 'warn';
      case 'contador':
        return 'info';
      default:
        return 'secondary';
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
        placeholder="Seleccione usuario"
        appendTo="body"
      />
      @if (invalid('usuario')) {
        <small class="err">Debe seleccionar un usuario</small>
      }
    </div>

    <div class="campo">
      <label for="script">Script <span class="req">*</span></label>
      <input
        pInputText
        id="script"
        formControlName="script"
        placeholder="Nombre del script a ejecutar"
      />
      @if (invalid('script')) {
        <small class="err">El script es obligatorio</small>
      }
    </div>

    <div class="acciones-form">
<p-button
          type="button"
          label="Cancelar"
          icon="pi pi-times"
          severity="secondary"
          size="small"
          rounded
          (onClick)="cancel()"
        />
      <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" rounded size="small" [loading]="guardando()" />
    </div>
  </form>
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-scripts\usuario-scripts-form.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosScriptsService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-scripts.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-scripts-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-scripts-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-scripts-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioScriptsForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuariosScriptsService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Asignar Script');
  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      script: ['', Validators.required],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service
      .create({
        usuario: raw.usuario,
        script: raw.script,
        empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId ?? 0,
      })
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Guardado',
            detail: 'Script asignado correctamente',
          });
          this.cancel();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Error',
            detail: 'No se pudo asignar el script',
          });
        },
      });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-scripts\usuario-scripts.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosScriptsService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-scripts.service';
import { UsuariosScripts } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-scripts',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-scripts.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-scripts.scss',
})
export class UsuarioScripts implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosScriptsService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuariosScripts[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuariosScripts[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los scripts',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((s) => {
        return (
          !q ||
          s.usuario.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          s.script.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuariosScripts, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar el script "${item.script}" de "${item.usuario}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.tusuarioscriptsId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Script eliminado correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar el script',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
// ===== Diamond Dark Sidebar Theme (copiado de junta-agua) =====

$sidebar-width: 320px;
$sidebar-collapsed-width: 56px;
$topbar-height: 60px;

// CSS variables estilo Diamond
:host {
  --d-sidebar-bg-color: rgba(11, 14, 23, 0.85);
  --d-sidebar-bg-color-alt: rgba(11, 14, 23, 0.85);
  --d-sidebar-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  --d-app-name-color: #ffffff;
  --d-menu-separator-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --d-menuitem-root-text-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  --d-menuitem-text-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  --d-menuitem-hover-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  --d-menuitem-active-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --d-menuitem-active-text-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  --d-menuitem-active-route-text-color: #ffffff;
  --d-menuitem-focus-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --p-panelmenu-panel-border-color: #1e2e3b;
}

// ===== Wrapper =====
.layout-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 100vh;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

// ===== Sidebar =====
.sidebar {
  width: $sidebar-width;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  border-right: var(--d-sidebar-border);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  transition: width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  user-select: none;
}

// ===== Sidebar Header =====
.sidebar-header {
  background: var(--d-sidebar-bg-color);
  height: $topbar-height;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 1rem 0 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: var(--d-menu-separator-border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.sidebar-close-mobile {
  display: none;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  cursor: pointer;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  &:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    color: white;

}

.sidebar-pin {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0;

  transition:
    background-color 0.15s,
    transform 0.3s;

  &.visible {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  &.pinned {
    background: var(--p-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
    border-color: var(--p-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
  }

.sidebar-logo {

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {

    padding: 0;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-panel) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-panel:not(:last-child)) {
    border-bottom: var(--d-menu-separator-border);
    padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header-content) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0;
    transition:
      background-color 0.15s,
      box-shadow 0.15s;
    outline: none;

    .p-panelmenu-header-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      font-weight: 500;
      text-decoration: none;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }


    .p-panelmenu-header-icon {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      min-width: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.05rem;
      
        // Font Awesome: ligeramente más compacto para alinearse con PrimeIcons
        &.fa-solid,
        &.fa-regular,
        &.fa-brands {
          font-size: 0.05rem;
        }
    }

    .p-panelmenu-header-label {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.925rem;
    }

    .p-panelmenu-panel {
      border-color: var(--p-panelmenu-panel-border-color);
    }

    .p-panelmenu-submenu-icon {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      margin-left: auto;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 0.875rem;
      height: 0.875rem;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }

    &:hover {
      background: var(--d-menuitem-hover-bg);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: var(--d-menuitem-focus-shadow);
    }
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header.p-panelmenu-header-active) {
    > .p-panelmenu-header-content {
      .p-panelmenu-header-icon,
      .p-panelmenu-header-label {
        color: var(--d-menuitem-active-route-text-color);
      }
    }
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-content) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-root-list) {
    outline: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-item) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-item-content) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0;
    transition:
      background-color 0.15s,
      box-shadow 0.15s;
    outline: none;

    .p-panelmenu-item-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem 0.45rem 1.75rem;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      font-weight: 500;
      text-decoration: none;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .p-panelmenu-item-icon {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      min-width: 0.55rem;
        font-size: 0.03rem;
      
        // Font Awesome: ligeramente más compacto para alinearse con PrimeIcons
        &.fa-solid,
        &.fa-regular,
        &.fa-brands {
          font-size: 0.3rem;
        }
    }

    .p-panelmenu-item-label {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-text-color);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
    }


    &:hover {
      background: var(--d-menuitem-hover-bg);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: var(--d-menuitem-focus-shadow);
    }
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header-link.p-panelmenu-item-link-active),
  :deep(.p-panelmenu-item-link.p-panelmenu-item-link-active) {
    background: var(--d-menuitem-active-bg);

    .p-panelmenu-header-icon,
    .p-panelmenu-header-label,
    .p-panelmenu-item-icon,
    .p-panelmenu-item-label,
    .p-panelmenu-submenu-icon {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-active-route-text-color) !important;
      font-weight: 600 !important;
    }
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-item.p-focus > .p-panelmenu-item-content) {
    background: var(--d-menuitem-active-bg);

    .p-panelmenu-item-icon,
    .p-panelmenu-item-label {
      color: var(--d-menuitem-active-route-text-color);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-submenu) {
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    list-style: none;
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;

    .p-panelmenu-item-link {
      padding-left: 2.75rem;
    }

    .p-panelmenu-submenu .p-panelmenu-item-link {
      padding-left: 3.75rem;
    }
  }
}

// ===== Main Area =====
.layout-main {
  flex: 1;
  margin-left: $sidebar-width;
  padding-top: $topbar-height;
  transition: margin-left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

// ===== Topbar =====
.topbar {
  height: $topbar-height;
  background: rgba(11, 14, 23, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  gap: 1rem;
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
  .sidebar-hidden .sidebar {
    width: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0;
  }

  .sidebar-hidden .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .topbar {
    left: $sidebar-width;
    transition: left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  }

  .sidebar-hidden .topbar {
    left: 0;
  }
}

.topbar-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.topbar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.user-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.9rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  transition:
    border-color var(--tr-fast),
    box-shadow var(--tr-fast),
    background var(--tr-fast);

  &:hover {
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
}

.user-chip-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.2;
  text-align: right;
}

.user-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.user-role {
  text-transform: capitalize;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.user-avatar {
  :deep(.p-avatar) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #fb923c 100%);
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
}

// Botón toggle del sidebar (naranja)
.sidebar-toggle {
  :deep(.p-button) {
    color: #fb923c;

    &:hover {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #fb923c 100%);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.4);
    }
  }
}

.hidden-mobile {
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    display: none;
  }
}

// Botón "Perfil" (splitbutton) sobre topbar dark
.profile-btn {
  :deep(.p-button) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);

    &:hover {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
    }
  }
}

// ===== Content =====
.layout-content {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  background:#1e2e3b;
}

// ===== Mobile Responsive =====
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .sidebar {
    transform: translateY(-110%);
    visibility: hidden;
    transition:
      transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
      visibility 0.45s;
    z-index: 200;
    min-height: 100vh;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);

    .sidebar-pin {
      display: none;
    }
    .sidebar-close-mobile {
      display: flex;
    }
  }

  .sidebar-overlay {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    z-index: 199;
  }

  .sidebar-open {
    .sidebar {
      transform: translateY(0);
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .sidebar-overlay {
      display: block;
    }
  }

  .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
  }

  .layout-content {
  padding: 0.5rem;
  }

  .sidebar-collapsed .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .topbar {
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
    z-index: 201;
  }

  .sidebar-toggle {
    .p-button {
      width: 2.75rem;
      height: 2.75rem;
    }
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\layout\main-layout\main-layout.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, DestroyRef, inject, signal, computed } from '@angular/core';
import { NavigationEnd, Router, RouterOutlet } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SplitButtonModule } from 'primeng/splitbutton';
import { AvatarModule } from 'primeng/avatar';
import { PanelMenuModule } from 'primeng/panelmenu';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { ConfirmationService, MenuItem } from 'primeng/api';
import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service';
import { MenuConfigService } from '../../core/services/menu-config.service';
import { QuickNavService } from '../../core/services/quick-nav.service';
import { Drawer, DrawerModule } from 'primeng/drawer';
import { QuickNav } from '../quick-nav/quick-nav';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-main-layout',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterOutlet,
    ButtonModule,
    AvatarModule,
    PanelMenuModule,
    ToastModule,
    ConfirmDialogModule,
    SplitButtonModule,
    TooltipModule,
    DrawerModule,
    QuickNav,
  ],
  templateUrl: './main-layout.html',
  styleUrl: './main-layout.scss',
})
export class MainLayout {
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private menuConfig = inject(MenuConfigService);
  /** Instancia del servicio de navegación rápida (botón del topbar) */
  readonly quickNav = inject(QuickNavService);

  mobileSidebarOpen = signal(false);
  sidebarHidden = signal(false);
  pinned = signal(false);

  visible: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    this.destroyRef.onDestroy(() =>
      this.router.events.subscribe((event) => {
        if (event instanceof NavigationEnd && window.innerWidth <= 768) {
          this.mobileSidebarOpen.set(false);
        }
      }),
    );
  }

  readonly user = this.auth.currentUser;

  menuItems = computed<MenuItem[]>(() =>
    this.menuConfig.getMenuItems().map((item) => this.mapItem(item)),
  );

  private mapItem(item: import('../../core/services/menu-config.service').MenuItemConfig): MenuItem {
    const mi: MenuItem = { label: item.label, icon: this.resolverIcono(item.icon) };
    if (item.route) mi.routerLink = [item.route];
    if (item.children?.length) {
      mi.expanded = false;
      mi.items = item.children.map((c) => this.mapItem(c));
    }
    return mi;
  }

  /**
   * Resuelve el ícono del MenuItem sin romper clases completas:
   *  - `'fa-solid fa-box'` / `'pi pi-home'` (con espacio) → se usa tal cual
   *  - `'fa-box'` (solo una clase FA) → se completa con `fa-solid`
   *  - `'pi-home'` → se completa con `pi `
   *  - `'home'` (nombre corto) → `pi pi-home` (compatibilidad con el formato viejo)
   */
  private resolverIcono(icon: string): string {
    const i = (icon ?? '').trim();
    if (!i) return '';
    if (i.includes(' ')) return i;
    if (i.startsWith('fa-')) return `fa-solid ${i}`;
    if (i.startsWith('pi-')) return `pi ${i}`;
    return `pi pi-${i}`;
  }

  userMenuItems: MenuItem[] = [
    { separator: true },
    { label: 'Cerrar Sesión', icon: 'pi pi-sign-out', command: () => this.cerrarSesion() },
  ];

  toggleSidebar() {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      this.mobileSidebarOpen.update((v) => !v);
      return;
    }
    this.sidebarHidden.update((v) => !v);
  }

  onMenuClick(event: MouseEvent) {
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) return;
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    const esNavegacion = !!target.closest('a[href]');
    if (esNavegacion) {
      this.mobileSidebarOpen.set(false);
    }
  }

  togglePin() {
    this.pinned.update((v) => !v);
    if (this.pinned()) {
      this.sidebarHidden.set(false);
    }
  }

  get toggleIcon(): string {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      return this.mobileSidebarOpen() ? 'pi pi-angle-left' : 'pi pi-bars';
    }
    return this.sidebarHidden() ? 'pi pi-angle-right' : 'pi pi-angle-left';
  }

  get initials(): string {
    const n = this.user()?.nombre || '';
    return n
      .split(' ')
      .map((w) => w[0])
      .join('')
      .toUpperCase()
      .slice(0, 2);
  }

  cerrarSesion() {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      header: 'Cerrar sesión',
      message: '¿Estás seguro de cerrar la sesión actual?',
      icon: 'pi pi-sign-out',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, cerrar sesión',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-text p-button-success p-button-rounded',
      rejectButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-text p-button-secondary p-button-rounded',
      accept: () => this.auth.logout(),
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\layout\quick-nav\quick-nav.html

```typescript
<p-dialog
  [visible]="nav.abierto()"
  (visibleChange)="nav.abierto.set($event)"
  header="Navegación rápida"
  [modal]="true"
  [draggable]="false"
  [resizable]="false"
  [focusOnShow]="true"
  [closeOnEscape]="true"
  [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }"
  styleClass="quick-nav-dialog"
  (onShow)="onShow()"
  (onHide)="onHide()"
>
  <div class="quick-nav-body">
    <div class="quick-nav-tabs">
      <p-selectButton
        [options]="tabs"
        [ngModel]="pestana()"
        (ngModelChange)="cambiarPestana($event)"
        optionLabel="label"
        optionValue="value"
        styleClass="quick-nav-tabgroup"
      />
      <span class="quick-nav-hint">{{ hintPestana }}</span>
    </div>

    <p-autoComplete
      [suggestions]="sugerencias()"
      [minLength]="0"
      [delay]="250"
      [showClear]="true"
      [autoHighlight]="true"
      [completeOnFocus]="true"
      [forceSelection]="false"
      [appendTo]="'body'"
      optionLabel="label"
      placeholder="Buscar pantalla o dato…"
      styleClass="quick-nav-input"
      inputStyleClass="quick-nav-input-el"
      panelStyleClass="quick-nav-panel"
      (completeMethod)="buscar($event.query)"
      (onSelect)="onSelect($event.value)"
      (onKeyUp)="onKeyup($event)"
      (onClear)="buscar('')"
    >
      <ng-template let-item pTemplate="item">
        <div class="quick-nav-item">
          <i [class]="item.icono"></i>
          <div class="quick-nav-item-text">
            <span class="quick-nav-item-label">{{ item.label }}</span>
            @if (item.detalle) {
              <span class="quick-nav-item-detalle">{{ item.detalle }}</span>
            }
          </div>
          <span class="quick-nav-item-tipo">{{ item.tipo }}</span>
        </div>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-template pTemplate="empty">
        <div class="quick-nav-empty">
          @if (cargando()) {
            <i class="pi pi-spin pi-spinner"></i>
            <span>Buscando…</span>
          } @else {
            <i class="pi pi-search"></i>
            <span>
              @if (pestana() === 'datos') {
                Sin resultados. Use 2 o más caracteres.
              } @else {
                Sin coincidencias.
              }
            </span>
          }
        </div>
      </ng-template>
    </p-autoComplete>

    <div class="quick-nav-footer">
      <div class="quick-nav-keys">
        <span class="kbd">Enter</span> ir
        <span class="kbd-sep">·</span>
        <span class="kbd">Esc</span> cerrar
        <span class="kbd-sep">·</span>
        <span class="kbd">Ctrl+Alt+1</span> abrir / cerrar
      </div>
      <div class="quick-nav-actions">
        <p-button
          size="small"
          label="Cerrar"
          rounded
          variant="text"
          severity="secondary"
          (onClick)="nav.cerrar()"
        />
        <p-button
          size="small"
          label="Ir"
          icon="pi pi-arrow-right"
          [rounded]="true"
          [raised]="true"
          severity="success"
          (onClick)="ir()"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</p-dialog>
```

```typescript
:host {
  display: contents;
}

.quick-nav-body {

  flex-direction: column;

}

  .quick-nav-hint {
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }
}

// Botones internos de p-selectButton (creados por PrimeNG → requieren ::ng-deep)
::ng-deep .quick-nav-tabgroup {
  .p-toggle-button {
    padding: 0.35rem 1.1rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }
}

  display: flex;

    font-size: 0.75rem;

      background: var(--c-surface-ground);
      color: var(--c-text);
      font-family: monospace;
      font-size: 0.72rem;

      opacity: 0.5;
    }

  .quick-nav-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    margin-left: auto;
  }
}

// ── Ítem de resultado ──────────────────────────────────────────────
.quick-nav-item {

  padding: 0.35rem 0.25rem;

  .quick-nav-item-text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1;

    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }

  .quick-nav-item-detalle {

    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }

  .quick-nav-item-tipo {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;

    background: var(--c-surface-ground);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }
}

.quick-nav-empty {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;

  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

// ── Estilos vía ::ng-deep (diálogo + panel del autocomplete) ──────
// Nombres de clase únicos: no afectan a otros diálogos de la app.
::ng-deep .quick-nav-dialog {
  width: 34rem;
  max-width: 92vw;

  .p-dialog-content {
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  }
}

::ng-deep .quick-nav-input {
  width: 100%;

  .quick-nav-input-el,
  input {
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
}

::ng-deep .quick-nav-panel {
  width: 34rem;
  max-width: 92vw;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);

    max-height: 320px;

    padding: 0.25rem;

  .p-autocomplete-option {
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  .p-autocomplete-option-highlight {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-primary) 14%, transparent);
    color: var(--c-text);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, DestroyRef, inject, signal, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { AutoCompleteModule, AutoComplete } from 'primeng/autocomplete';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { QuickNavItem, QuickNavService } from '../../core/services/quick-nav.service';

type Pestana = 'menu' | 'datos';

/**
 * Navegación rápida global (Ctrl+Alt+1).
 *
 * Un solo cuadro con dos modos:
 *  - Menú: autocompletado sobre los ítems del menú lateral → navega a la ruta.
 *  - Datos: búsqueda global en clientes, proveedores, productos y cuentas contables.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-quick-nav',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, DialogModule, SelectButtonModule, AutoCompleteModule, ButtonModule, TooltipModule],
  templateUrl: './quick-nav.html',
  styleUrl: './quick-nav.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class QuickNav {
  readonly nav = inject(QuickNavService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  @ViewChild(AutoComplete) private ac?: AutoComplete;

  readonly tabs: { label: string; value: Pestana }[] = [
    { label: 'Menú', value: 'menu' },
    { label: 'Datos', value: 'datos' },
  ];

  readonly pestana = signal<Pestana>('menu');
  readonly sugerencias = signal<QuickNavItem[]>([]);
  readonly cargando = signal(false);
  readonly seleccionado = signal<QuickNavItem | null>(null);

  private queryActual = '';
  private reqId = 0;
  private navegoConEnter = false;

  buscar(query: string): void {
    this.queryActual = query ?? '';
    this.navegoConEnter = false;

    if (this.pestana() === 'menu') {
      this.sugerencias.set(this.nav.filtrarMenu(this.queryActual));
      this.cargando.set(false);
      return;
    }

    const termino = this.queryActual.trim();
    if (termino.length < 2) {
      this.sugerencias.set([]);
      this.cargando.set(false);
      return;
    }

    const id = ++this.reqId;
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.nav
      .buscarDatos(termino)
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          if (id !== this.reqId) return;
          this.sugerencias.set(res);
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          if (id !== this.reqId) return;
          this.sugerencias.set([]);
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
      });
  }

  cambiarPestana(valor: Pestana): void {
    if (this.pestana() === valor) return;
    this.pestana.set(valor);
    this.sugerencias.set([]);
    this.buscar(this.queryActual);
    this.enfocar();
  }

  onShow(): void {
    this.seleccionado.set(null);
    this.navegoConEnter = false;
    this.queryActual = '';
    this.sugerencias.set(this.nav.filtrarMenu(''));
    this.enfocar();
  }

  onHide(): void {
    this.pestana.set('menu');
    this.cargando.set(false);
    // No resetear navegoConEnter aquí: el keyup de Enter llega DESPUÉS de ocultar
    // el panel y, si se resetea, se navegaría una 2ª vez a sugerencias()[0].
  }

  onSelect(event: { value?: QuickNavItem } | QuickNavItem | null): void {
    // PrimeNG emite { originalEvent, value } — normalizar por si llega el objeto plano
    const item = event && 'value' in event ? event.value : (event as QuickNavItem | null);
    if (!item) return;
    this.seleccionado.set(item);
    this.navegoConEnter = true;
    this.ir(item);
  }

  onKeyup(event: Event): void {
    // Diálogo cerrado → no reaccionar (el keyup llega tarde, tras el cierre)
    if (!this.nav.abierto()) return;
    const e = event as KeyboardEvent;
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    // PrimeNG ya seleccionó la opción resaltada → onSelect() se encarga
    if (this.navegoConEnter) {
      this.navegoConEnter = false;
      return;
    }
    const primero = this.sugerencias()[0];
    if (primero) this.ir(primero);
  }

  ir(item?: QuickNavItem | null): void {
    const destino = item ?? this.seleccionado() ?? this.sugerencias()[0];
    if (!destino) return;
    this.nav.navegar(destino);
  }

  get hintPestana(): string {
    return this.pestana() === 'menu'
      ? 'Escriba para buscar una pantalla del sistema'
      : 'Escriba 2+ caracteres para buscar clientes, proveedores, productos o cuentas';
  }

  private enfocar(): void {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const input = (this.ac as unknown as { inputEL?: { nativeElement?: HTMLInputElement } } | undefined)?.inputEL
        ?.nativeElement;
      input?.focus();
      input?.select();
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
body {

/* =====================================================
   Animaciones de entrada
   ===================================================== */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes pulseSoft {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .page > * {
    animation: fadeInUp var(--tr-smooth) both;
  }

  .page > *:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.04s;
  }
  .page > *:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.08s;
  }
  .page > *:nth-child(4) {
    animation-delay: 0.12s;
  }
}

/* Skeleton shimmer */
@keyframes shimmer {
  from {
    background-position: 200% 0;
  }
  to {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
}

.p-skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eef2f7 25%, #e2e8f0 50%, #eef2f7 75%) !important;

}

/* =====================================================

}

}

}

}

}

/* Tablas */
.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

/* =====================================================
   DataView cards (catálogos)
   ===================================================== */
.dv-cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.dv-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--tr-base),
    border-color var(--tr-base),
    transform var(--tr-base);

  &:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);

  .dv-top {
    display: flex;

    justify-content: space-between;

      font-size: 0.95rem;

      color: var(--c-text);

  }

  .dv-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .dv-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;

  .dv-actions {

.p-dataview-content {

}

.monto {

  font-weight: 600;
}

/* =====================================================
   Impresión de reportes
   ===================================================== */
@media print {
  .layout-wrapper .sidebar,
  .layout-wrapper .topbar,
  .no-print,
  .filtros,
  .page-header button,
  .p-paginator {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
  }

  .layout-content {
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  body {
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  .card {
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  .print-only {
    display: block !important;
  }
}

.print-only {
  display: none;
}

/* Encabezado de reporte impreso */
.print-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }
  p {
    margin: 0.2rem 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #475569;
  }
}

/* Tarjetas de totales (reportes) */
.totales-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;

  .total-card {
    background: var(--c-surface-muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;

    .label {

      text-transform: uppercase;

    }
    .value {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
  --c-amarillo: #f5e949ef;

  --radius-sm: 0.5rem;
  --radius-md: 0.75rem;
  --radius-lg: 1.25rem;
  --radius-full: 9999px;



  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61, 139, 255, 0.35);

  --tr-fast: 150ms ease;
  --tr-base: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --tr-smooth: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);

  --p-button-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-button-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-button-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-inputtext-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-inputtext-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-inputtext-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-select-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-select-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-select-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-textarea-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-textarea-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-textarea-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-datepicker-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-datepicker-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-datepicker-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-inputicon-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-paginator-font-size: 0.875rem;

  --p-form-field-background: #213341;
  --p-form-field-border-color: #39495b;


  --p-navigation-item-color: #7f8790;
  --p-navigation-item-icon-color: #558dc6;

  --p-panelmenu-item-focus-color: #558dc6;
  --p-navigation-submenu-icon-color: #558dc6;


  --p-card-title-font-size: 1.05rem;
  --p-card-background: var(--p-form-field-background);

  --p-inputtext-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  --p-inputtext-background: #213341;
  --p-inputtext-border-color: #39495b;
  --p-inputtext-disabled-color: var(--c-text-muted);
  --p-inputtext-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-inputtext-disabled-border-color: #2a3a4a;
  --p-inputtext-invalid-border-color: var(--c-danger);

  --p-togglebutton-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  ---p-togglebutton-background: var(--color-texto-input);


  // para los botones selecionados del toggle button
  --p-togglebutton-checked-color: var(--c-success);
  --p-togglebutton-content-checked-background: var(--p-inputtext-background);


  --p-togglebutton-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-togglebutton-checked-background: var(--c-bg);

  --p-togglebutton-hover-color: var(--c-amarillo);
  --p-togglebutton-border-color: var(--c-bg);
  --p-togglebutton-checked-border-color: var(--c-bg);


  --p-select-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  --p-select-background: var(--p-form-field-background);
  --p-select-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-select-disabled-color: var(--c-text-muted);

  --p-inputnumber-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-datepicker-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);

  --p-toolbar-border-color: var(--for-border-color-alls);

  --p-datatable-body-cell-border-color: #25374a;
  --p-datatable-header-cell-border-color: #25374a;
  --p-datatable-header-cell-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  --p-datatable-body-cell-sm-padding: 0.275rem 0.1rem;



  --p-tag-secondary-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-success-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-info-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-warn-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-danger-background: var(--c-bg-muted);

  --p-tag-rounded-border-radius: 5px 5px 5px 5px;

  --surface-border: var(--for-border-color-alls);

--p-button-contrast-background: var(--c-bg-black);
  --p-button-contrast-border-color: var(--c-bg-black);
  --p-button-contrast-color: var(--c-bg-white);
}


body {
  font-family: var(--font-family);
  color: var(--c-text);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

label {
  color: var(--c-text);
  /* Color del texto */
}

thead th {
  color: var(--c-text);
}

tr {
  color: var(--c-text);
}


ul {
  display: block;
  list-style-type: none;
  margin-block-start: 1em;
  margin-block-end: 1em;
  padding-inline-start: 12px;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}


.p-inputtext {
  color: var(--c-text);
  /* Color del texto */
}

.p-select {
  color: var(--c-text);
  /* Color del texto */
}

.p-card {
  --p-card-body-padding: 0.75rem;
  /* O el valor que prefieras, ej: 10px, 0.5rem */
}

.tabla-card {
  padding: 0.05rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 12px;

}

/* =====================================================
   Animaciones de entrada
   ===================================================== */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes pulseSoft {

  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  50% {
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .page>* {
    animation: fadeInUp var(--tr-smooth) both;
  }

  .page>*:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.04s;
  }

  .page>*:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.08s;
  }

  .page>*:nth-child(4) {
    animation-delay: 0.12s;
  }
}

/* Skeleton shimmer */
@keyframes shimmer {
  from {
    background-position: 200% 0;
  }

  to {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
}

.p-skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eef2f7 25%, #e2e8f0 50%, #eef2f7 75%) !important;
  background-size: 200% 100% !important;
  animation: shimmer 1.6s infinite !important;
}

/* =====================================================
   Estilos compartidos de páginas
   ===================================================== */

.page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.page-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  .page-header-text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
  }
}

.w-full {
  width: 100%;
}

.page-title {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.page-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin: 0;
}

/* Tarjeta genérica */
.card {
  background: var(--c-bg);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--for-border-color-alls);

}

// =====================================================
// Tablas responsive con scroll horizontal
// =====================================================
.p-datatable-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;

  table {
    min-width: max-content;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .p-datatable-wrapper {
    margin: 0 -0.75rem;
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-table {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-tbody>tr>td {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .p-datatable-thead>tr>th {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem !important;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .p-paginator {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0 !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// Mejoras táctiles / accesibilidad
// =====================================================
@media (pointer: coarse) {

  .p-button,
  .p-inputtext,
  .p-select,
  .p-datepicker {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// Responsive: compartido
// =====================================================
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .page-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;

    >div:first-child {
      width: 100%;
    }

    >div:last-child,
    >p-button {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;

      button,
      .p-button {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
    }
  }

  .card {
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  .totales-grid {
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .nf-totales-row {
        .nf-total-block {
          flex: 1 1 45%;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/* Bloque de filtros */
.filtros {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  .campo {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;

    label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--c-text-secondary);
    }

    &.acciones {
      flex-direction: row;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .campo {
      width: 100%;

      input,
      p-select,
      p-button,
      .p-select,
      .p-inputtext {
        width: 100%;
      }

      &.acciones {
        flex-direction: column;

        button,
        .p-button {
          width: 100%;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/* Tablas */
.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

/* =====================================================
   DataView cards (catálogos)
   ===================================================== */
.dv-cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.dv-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--tr-base),
    border-color var(--tr-base),
    transform var(--tr-base);

  &:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
  }

  .dv-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .dv-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
    }
  }

  .dv-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .dv-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;

    .dv-label {
      color: var(--c-text-faint);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .dv-value {
      color: var(--c-text-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;

      &.dv-monto {
        color: var(--c-success);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
    }
  }

  .dv-actions {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    padding: 0.85rem 0.9rem;
  }
}

.p-dataview-content {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.monto {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* =====================================================
   Impresión de reportes
   ===================================================== */
@media print {

  .layout-wrapper .sidebar,
  .layout-wrapper .topbar,
  .no-print,
  .filtros,
  .page-header button,
  .p-paginator {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
  }

  .layout-content {
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  body {
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  .card {
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  .print-only {
    display: block !important;
  }
}

.print-only {
  display: none;
}

/* Encabezado de reporte impreso */
.print-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }

  p {
    margin: 0.2rem 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #475569;
  }
}

/* Tarjetas de totales (reportes) */
.totales-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;

  .total-card {
    background: var(--c-surface-muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;

    .label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--c-text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .value {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }
  }
}
```
